title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Maltese tycoon found not guilty of involvement in Daphne Caruana Galizia murder
title.zh: 被指控谋杀记者的马耳他巨头无罪

summary.en: Yorgen Fenech, one of Malta's wealthiest individuals, has been acquitted of charges related to the 2017 murder of anti-corruption journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The verdict, which is subject to appeal, is a setback for press freedom advocates and the victim's family.
summary.zh: 马耳他最富有的人之一约尔根·芬内赫（Yorgen Fenech）被判无罪，他面临与2017年反腐记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚（Daphne Caruana Galizia）谋杀案有关的指控。该判决可能会被上诉，这对新闻自由的倡导者和受害者家属来说是一个打击。

body.en: Yorgen Fenech cleared on both charges he faced over 2017 killing of journalist that prompted global outrage One of Malta’s richest men has been found not guilty of involvement in the murder of the anti-corruption journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The verdict, which is expected to be appealed against by the prosecution, will come as a blow not only to the victim’s family, but to the politicians and campaigners who regard the case as a landmark action in the fight to protect press freedom in Europe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 洗清了他因 2017 年杀害记者而引发全球愤怒的两项指控。马耳他最富有的人之一因参与谋杀反腐败记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia) 而被判无罪。预计检方将对这一判决提出上诉，这不仅对受害者家属是一个打击，对那些认为此案是欧洲保护新闻自由斗争中具有里程碑意义的行动的政治家和活动家来说也是一个打击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The acquittal of Yorgen Fenech in the murder of Daphne Caruana Galizia leaves a profound sense of injustice for those who sought accountability. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves not only upholding justice but also acting with mercy, a balance that feels urgently needed when powerful figures are involved in grave crimes. May we...
reflection.zh: 约尔根·芬内赫在达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚谋杀案中被判无罪，这让那些寻求问责的人感到深深的不公。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义不仅在于维护正义，还在于施行慈爱，当权势人物卷入严重罪行时，这种平衡显得尤为迫切。 愿我们为追求正义者的智慧和勇气祷告，也为那些旨在保护弱者并追究掌权者责任的体制的廉正祷告。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Gun found in French lake is analysed by 2012 Alps killings investigators
title.zh: 法国湖中发现的手枪正由2012年阿尔卑斯山命案调查人员进行分析

summary.en: A Luger pistol, reportedly found by British tourists in a French lake, is being analyzed by investigators of the 2012 Alps killings. This discovery is the latest in a series of potential leads in the unsolved mystery of the al-Hilli family's murder, where Saad al-Hilli, his wife Ikbal, and her mother were shot dead...
summary.zh: 据报道，英国游客在法国一个湖中发现了一把鲁格手枪，目前该枪正被2012年阿尔卑斯山命案的调查人员进行分析。这一发现是解开阿尔-希利一家神秘命案谜团的最新潜在线索之一。萨阿德·阿尔-希利（50岁）、他的妻子伊克巴尔（47岁）和她的母亲苏海拉·阿尔-阿拉夫（74岁）于2012年9月在法国东部安纳西附近的一个偏远阿尔卑斯山村...

body.en: British tourists reportedly discovered Luger pistol that is latest in long line of potential leads in mystery of al-Hilli deaths Experts are examining a gun found by tourists to determine whether it might have been used to kill a British family in the French Alps 14 years ago. In what remains an unsolved murder case, Saad al-Hilli, 50, his wife, Ikbal, 47, and her mother Suhaila al-Allaf, 74, were shot dead on a road near Annecy, a remote Alpine village in eastern France in September 2012. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据报道，英国游客发现了鲁格手枪，这是阿尔希利死亡之谜一长串潜在线索中的最新一例。专家正在检查游客发现的一把枪，以确定这支手枪是否可能是 14 年前在法国阿尔卑斯山杀死一个英国家庭所用的。 2012 年 9 月，50 岁的萨阿德·阿尔希利 (Saad al-Hilli)、47 岁的妻子伊克巴尔 (Ikbal) 和 74 岁的母亲苏海拉·阿拉夫 (Suhaila al-Allaf) 在法国东部偏远的阿尔卑斯山村庄安纳西 (Annecy) 附近的道路上被枪杀，这是一桩悬而未决的谋杀案。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Fourteen years after the brutal murders of the al-Hilli family, the discovery of a potential weapon in a lake offers a glimmer of hope for justice. This echoes the cycle of violence that ensnares so many, reminding us of Jesus' words to Peter: 'Put your sword back in its place... for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.' May this find bring closure...
reflection.zh: 在阿尔-希利一家惨遭杀害十四年后，在湖中发现一把潜在凶器为伸张正义带来了一线希望。这呼应了困扰许多人的暴力循环，使我们想起耶稣对彼得说的话：“把你的剑收回鞘里去……因为凡动刀的，必死在刀下。”愿这一发现能为悲痛的家人带来慰藉与和平。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Hakeem Jeffries vows ‘serious response’ after two House Democrats vote with Republicans – US politics live
title.zh: 哈基姆·杰弗里斯誓言“严肃回应”，因两名众议院民主党人与共和党人投票

summary.en: House minority leader Hakeem Jeffries stated that the decision by two Democrats to advance a resolution condemning socialism represents a "significant breach of trust." This comes as US military forces resume strikes on Iran, and Donald Trump makes social media posts about his construction projects.
summary.zh: 众议院少数党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯表示，两名民主党人推进一项谴责社会主义的决议的决定“严重破坏了信任”。与此同时，美军恢复了对伊朗的打击，唐纳德·特朗普则在社交媒体上发布了关于他建筑项目的帖子。

body.en: House minority leader says decision by two Democrats to advance resolution condemning socialism ‘represents significant breach of trust’ Sign up for the US Breaking News email As tensions flare in the mideast with American military forces resuming strikes on Iran, Donald Trump has taken to social media to discuss his ballroom project. “We have hundreds of happy construction workers in D.C. busily doing their job building the finest Ballroom/Military complex anywhere in the World,” Trump said in a truth social post Wednesday morning. “There is nothing like it, and never will be! It was a long, hard, fight in the Court System, but the winner is, as always under ‘TRUMP,’ the U.S.A.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 众议院少数党领袖表示，两名民主党人决定推进谴责社会主义的决议，“代表着对信任的严重破坏”。随着美国军队恢复对伊朗的打击，中东局势紧张，唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上讨论了他的舞厅项目。特朗普周三早上在一篇真实的社交帖子中表示：“我们在华盛顿有数百名快乐的建筑工人正忙着建造世界上最好的宴会厅/军事综合体。” “没有什么比这更好的了，也永远不会有这样的事！这是法院系统中一场漫长而艰苦的斗争，但胜利者是一如既往，在‘特朗普’统治下的美国。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political maneuvering and party loyalty are tested when individuals cross lines. The principle of righteous rule, as described in Proverbs 16:12, calls leaders to govern with integrity and justice, ensuring that their actions build trust rather than fracture it. The breach of trust mentioned by Leader Jeffries underscores the importance of ethical conduct...
reflection.zh: 当个人跨越界限时，政治策略和党派忠诚将受到考验。箴言16:12所描述的公义统治原则，呼吁领导者以正直和公正来治理，确保他们的行为建立信任而非破坏信任。杰弗里斯领袖提到的信任破裂，凸显了道德行为在维持治理机构的稳定和功能方面的重要性。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Bayeux tapestry loan symbolises ‘entente amicale’ between France and UK, says King Charles
title.zh: 英王查尔斯称《贝叶挂毯》的借展象征英法‘友好谅解’

summary.en: King Charles stated that the loan of the Bayeux tapestry to the British Museum is the best symbol of the 'entente amicale' between France and the UK. He noted that the tapestry, which depicts a conflict, now serves as a precious symbol of trust, particularly relevant in a time when trust between nations is scarce.
summary.zh: 英王查尔斯表示，将贝叶挂毯借展至大英博物馆是英法两国“友好谅解”的最佳象征。他指出，这幅描绘冲突的挂毯如今已成为信任的珍贵象征，尤其是在国家间信任稀缺的时代。

body.en: Monarch tells Emmanuel Macron at the British Museum in London that the two nations will share a future ‘woven together’ by history and shared values The loan of the Bayeux tapestry was the “the best possible symbol” of the “entente amicale” between France and the UK, King Charles said as he visited the famous embroidered masterpiece at the British Museum in London. Though the tapestry recounts a conflict, “here it is today, nearly 1,000 years later, as a precious symbol of trust, at a time when trust seems sadly to be in short supply between nations,” he said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 君主在伦敦大英博物馆告诉埃马纽埃尔·马克龙，两国将共享一个由历史和共同价值观“编织在一起”的未来。查尔斯国王在参观伦敦大英博物馆著名的刺绣杰作时表示，借出的贝叶挂毯是法国和英国之间“友好协议”的“最佳象征”。尽管这幅挂毯讲述了一场冲突，但“在近 1000 年后的今天，它作为信任的珍贵象征，在国家之间似乎缺乏信任的时代，”他说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Bayeux tapestry, a narrative of historical conflict, is now loaned as a symbol of trust between France and the UK. King Charles highlighted its significance in an era where international trust is fragile. This act of sharing a piece of history, even one born of strife, speaks to the possibility of building bridges and fostering goodwill, reminding us...
reflection.zh: 贝叶挂毯，这幅讲述历史冲突的叙事画卷，如今被借展作为英法两国之间信任的象征。查尔斯国王强调了它在国际信任脆弱的时代的重要性。这种分享历史片段的行为，即使是源于纷争的历史，也体现了建立桥梁和促进友善的可能性，提醒我们即使是古老的争端，也能成为今日和睦的基础。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Lindsay Clancy jurors say they’re deadlocked for a second time
title.zh: 林赛·克兰西案陪审团第二次表示无法达成一致

summary.en: The jury in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, accused of killing her three children, has informed the judge for the second time that they are deadlocked and unable to reach a verdict. Further deliberations have been ordered, with a mistrial potentially declared if they remain unable to agree.
summary.zh: 在母亲林赛·克兰西被控谋杀三名子女的案件中，陪审团周三第二次告知法官，他们无法就判决达成一致。陪审团已被要求继续审议，如果第三次仍无法达成一致，该案将可能被宣布为无效审判。

body.en: Jury sent back for more deliberations in case of mother accused of murdering her three children Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email The jury in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial on Wednesday told the judge for a second time that it can’t agree on a verdict in the controversial case of the mother accused of murdering her three children. The jury were then sent back for more deliberations but if they remain deadlocked for a third time a mistrial is set to be called in the high-profile case. Continue reading...
body.zh: 陪审团对被控谋杀三个孩子的母亲一案发回进一步审议 周三，林赛·克兰西谋杀案审判中的陪审团第二次告诉法官，他们不能就被控谋杀三个孩子的母亲这一有争议的案件做出裁决。陪审团随后被送回进行更多审议，但如果他们第三次仍陷入僵局，这起备受瞩目的案件将被宣告无效审判。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The persistent deadlock in the Lindsay Clancy trial underscores the agonizing complexity of justice, especially when the alleged victims are children. It speaks to the deep human struggle to find clarity and resolution in the face of profound tragedy and conflicting narratives. In such moments, we are reminded of the ancient call to defend the vulnerable...
reflection.zh: 林赛·克兰西案中持续的僵局，凸显了司法公正的痛苦复杂性，尤其是在受害者是孩子的情况下。它反映了人类在面对深重悲剧和相互矛盾的叙述时，在寻求清晰和解决之道上的艰难挣扎。 在这样的时刻，我们被提醒要响应古老的呼召，去捍卫弱者，寻求真正的公义，即使道路被悲伤和不确定性所遮蔽。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Unity at last: Is Libya's damaging power struggle at an end?
title.zh: 终于团结：利比亚破坏性的权力斗争是否结束了？

summary.en: For over a decade, Libya has been divided between two opposing governments. Elections, intended to end the rivalry and unite the country, are now scheduled within two years.
summary.zh: 十多年来，利比亚一直分裂为两个对立的政府。旨在结束竞争并统一国家的选举现已定于两年内举行。

body.en:
For over a decade, Libya has been split between two opposing governments. Elections, meant to end the rivalry and unite the country, are now scheduled within two years.

There have been other attempts made in the past but this time, those involved hope it will finally work out: Thanks to mediation by the United Nations , the two opposing governments in the west and east of Libya have agreed that they will hold parliamentary and presidential elections within the next two years.

"The agreement marks an important step in advancing Libya towards national elections and ending the transitional period," the UN's Support Mission in Libya, or UNSMIL, said in a statement.

Among other things, the country's electoral commission will be restructured and, according to the UN, various points about the legal framework for the elections that had previously led to disagreements have now been resolved.

But whether all this will actually result in free and fair elections in Libya remains to be seen.

After former Libyan dictator Moammar Gadhafi was overthrown in 2011, Libya ended up divided in two.

Since 2014, the country has been split between opposing governments located in the east and west of the country. A UN-backed administration known as the Government of National Unity is based in Tripoli in the west, and its rival, known as the House of Representatives, is based in the east, in Tobruk.

Former warlord-turned-politician Khalifa Haftar, is based in the east while Prime Minister Abdul-Hamid Dbeibah is in charge in the west.

Each is supported by a number of local militias and foreign powers, and each has tried to wrest control from the other. Up until now, attempts to hold an election that would unite the country have failed.

For Andreas Dittmann, a geographic conflict expert and professor at the University of Giessen in Hesse, central Germany, the apparent unity is a positive .

After years of civil war and political division, the desire of many Libyans to end the fighting permanently has only grown. Dittmann believes the attitudes of political actors have also changed in this regard.

Previously foreign actors had supported just one Libyan government, but now that has also changed and the prevailing argument seems to be that Libya can only develop further if both sides are incorporated into one administration.

This is why the UN is trying to go beyond simply arranging a date for elections. It also wants to strengthen the electoral commission and work on electoral laws. The new and united government will be responsible for establishing the conditions for a secure and trusted electoral process . 

The UN has also set up what it calls "Structured Dialogues," during which consensus was...
body.zh: 十多年来，利比亚一直分裂为两个对立的政府。旨在结束竞争并团结国家的选举现在定于两年内举行。 过去也曾进行过其他尝试，但这一次，相关人士希望最终能够成功：在联合国的调解下，利比亚西部和东部的两个对立政府已同意在未来两年内举行议会和总统选举。 联合国利比亚支持团（联利支助团）在一份声明中表示：“该协议标志着推动利比亚走向全国选举和结束过渡期的重要一步。” 除其他事项外，该国的选举委员会将进行重组，根据联合国的说法，此前导致分歧的有关选举法律框架的各种问题现已得到解决。 但这一切是否真的会导致利比亚举行自由公正的选举还有待观察。 2011 年，前利比亚独裁者卡扎菲被推翻后，利比亚最终分裂为两部分。 自 2014 年以来，该国在东部和西部的对立政府之间分裂。联合国支持的政府，称为民族团结政府，总部位于西部的黎波里，其竞争对手，即众议院，总部位于东部托布鲁克。 前军阀出身的政治家哈利法·哈夫塔尔（Khalifa Haftar）驻扎东部，而总理阿卜杜勒·哈米德·德贝巴（Abdul-Hamid Dbeibah）负责西部。 每个国家都得到了一些当地民兵和外国势力的支持，并且每个国家都试图从对方手中夺取控制权。到目前为止，举行全国团结选举的尝试都以失败告终。 对于地理冲突专家、德国中部黑森州吉森大学教授安德烈亚斯·迪特曼 (Andreas Dittmann) 来说，表面上的团结是积极的。 经过多年的内战和政治分裂，许多利比亚人永久结束战斗的愿望有增无减。迪特曼认为，政治参与者的态度在这方面也发生了变化。 以前外国势力只支持利比亚一个政府，但现在情况也发生了变化，普遍的观点似乎是，只有双方都并入一个政府，利比亚才能进一步发展。 这就是为什么联合国不仅仅只是安排选举日期。它还希望加强选举委员会和选举法方面的工作。新的联合政府将负责为安全和可信的选举进程创造条件。 联合国还建立了所谓的“结构性对话”，在此期间达成了共识……

reflection.en: After more than ten years of division, the UN's mediation has brought Libya's opposing governments to an agreement for elections within two years. This marks a hopeful step towards national unity and an end to the prolonged conflict. May this fragile peace hold and lead to lasting stability for the Libyan people.
reflection.zh: 经过十多年的分裂，在联合国的斡旋下，利比亚的对立政府已达成协议，将在两年内举行选举。这标志着迈向国家团结和结束长期冲突的希望一步。愿这脆弱的和平得以维持，并为利比亚人民带来持久的稳定。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
title.zh: 伊朗袭击沙特油轮致两名菲律宾海员丧生，沙特称

summary.en: The kingdom condemns the targeting of Sidr, which was reportedly hit by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, resulting in the deaths of two Filipino sailors.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯称，周一在霍尔木兹海峡，其拥有的油轮“Sidr”号遭不明弹丸袭击，导致两名菲律宾海员丧生，沙特谴责了此次袭击。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia has condemned what it said was an Iranian attack on a Saudi-owned supertanker on Monday night that killed two Filipino sailors.

The Saudi national shipping company, Bahri, confirmed on Wednesday that its vessel Sidr was "involved in a security incident while transiting the Strait of Hormuz".

Sidr was hit by projectiles north of Oman's Musandam Peninsula, according to maritime security firms. A South Korean-owned supertanker, Senegal Prosperity, was reportedly struck east of Musandam around the same time.

Iran has not responded to the Saudi allegation. But it said earlier that two tankers had caught fire after hitting mines while using an unauthorised route through the strait.

The news of the sailors' deaths came after the US military carried out a wave of air strikes on Iran and Iranian forces targeted US bases in neighbouring Arab states with missiles and drones in their biggest exchange of fire since July .

On Wednesday Iran's health minister said 18 people were killed and 108 injured in the US attacks. Iran has accused the US of a "war crime" over a strike that killed four people including two children at a wedding party in the southern city of Sirik. The US military said it was looking into the reports.

Shipping company Bahri's statement said the unspecified "security incident" affecting Sidr happened in the Strait of Hormuz at around 23:40 local time (19:40 GMT) on Monday.

"It is with profound sadness that Bahri confirms the loss of two of its Filipino seafarers as a result of the incident," it added. "The company extends its deepest condolences and heartfelt sympathies to their families, loved ones, and colleagues during this difficult time."

Later, the Saudi foreign ministry expressed the kingdom's condemnation of "Iran's targeting of the Saudi tanker (Sidr) while it was transiting the Strait of Hormuz".

It also condemned the recent Iranian attacks on Jordan, Bahrain and Kuwait, and stressed the "need to halt escalation and respect the security and safety of international navigation", as well as the security of global energy supplies, national sovereignty, and international law.

The statements were issued a day after maritime risk management and intelligence firms Marisks and Kpler reported that two tankers each loaded with two million barrels of Saudi crude oil were struck by unknown projectiles within minutes of each other as they transited outbound through the Strait of Hormuz late on Monday.

Sidr was struck by "unknown projectiles" at 19:52 GMT about 16 nautical miles (30km) north-east of Khasab, Oman, while Senegal Prosperity was struck by "three unknown projectiles" about 17 nautical miles east of Khasab, according to Marisks.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency also reported two incidents in the same...
body.zh: 沙特阿拉伯谴责周一晚间伊朗袭击沙特拥有的一艘超级油轮，造成两名菲律宾水手死亡。 沙特国家航运公司Bahri周三证实，其船只Sidr“在经过霍尔木兹海峡时卷入安全事件”。 据海事安全公司称，“锡德尔”号在阿曼穆桑达姆半岛北部遭到炮弹袭击。据报道，韩国拥有的超级油轮“Senegal Prosperity”号大约在同一时间在穆桑代姆以东遭到袭击。 伊朗尚未对沙特的指控做出回应。但该公司早些时候表示，两艘油轮在未经授权通过海峡时触雷后起火。 水手死亡的消息传出之前，美国军方对伊朗发动了一波空袭，伊朗军队用导弹和无人机瞄准了美国在邻国阿拉伯国家的基地，这是自 7 月以来最大规模的交火。 伊朗卫生部长周三表示，美国的袭击造成 18 人死亡、108 人受伤。伊朗指责美国在南部城市锡里克的一场婚礼上发动袭击，造成四人死亡，其中包括两名儿童，犯有“战争罪”。美国军方表示正在调查这些报道。 航运公司Bahri的声明称，影响锡德尔号的未具体说明的“安全事件”于周一当地时间23:40左右（格林威治标准时间19:40）发生在霍尔木兹海峡。 声明补充说：“巴里公司非常悲伤地证实，两名菲律宾海员因该事件而丧生。” “在这个困难时期，公司向他们的家人、亲人和同事致以最深切的哀悼和衷心的慰问。” 随后，沙特外交部表达了该国对“伊朗在沙特油轮（Sidr）通过霍尔木兹海峡时对其进行袭击”的谴责。 它还谴责伊朗最近对约旦、巴林和科威特的袭击，并强调“需要停止升级并尊重国际航行的安全和保障”，以及全球能源供应、国家主权和国际法的安全。 该声明是在海事风险管理和情报公司 Maririsks 和 Kpler 报告称，两艘油轮周一晚间通过霍尔木兹海峡出境时，在几分钟内被不明弹丸击中，每艘油轮各载有 200 万桶沙特原油。 据马里斯克斯称，西德尔号于格林威治标准时间 19 点 52 分在阿曼海塞卜东北约 16 海里（30 公里）处被“不明弹丸”击中，而塞内加尔繁荣号在海塞卜以东约 17 海里处被“三枚未知弹丸”击中。 英国海事贸易运营机构还报告了同一地区发生的两起事件……

reflection.en: The attack on the Sidr tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, which claimed the lives of two Filipino sailors, is a tragic escalation in a volatile region. In the face of such violence, the call to overcome evil with good, rather than retaliating in kind, offers a path toward breaking destructive cycles. May wisdom guide leaders to seek peace and protect innocent...
reflection.zh: 在霍尔木兹海峡，Sidr油轮遇袭并导致两名菲律宾海员丧生，这是该地区紧张局势中又一令人痛心的暴力升级。面对这样的暴力，不以恶报恶、反而要以善胜恶的呼吁，为打破破坏性的循环指明了方向。愿智慧引导领导者寻求和平，保护无辜的生命免受冲突的伤害。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Woman charged with juror intimidation in Lindsay Clancy trial
title.zh: 女子因在克兰西审判中恐吓陪审员而被起诉

summary.en: Dawn Light is accused of taking photos of jurors outside the Plymouth courthouse, a practice prohibited by the court.
summary.zh: 唐恩·莱特被指控在普利茅斯法院外拍摄陪审员，此举为法院所禁止。

body.en:
A woman, who was arrested for taking photos of jury members outside the courthouse in the Lindsay Clancy trial, has been charged with aggravated intimidation of a juror.

Dawn Light, 56, is accused of sitting in a restricted area outside the Plymouth courthouse and photographing jurors as they exited the building on Tuesday. Her lawyer called it a misunderstanding as she pleaded not guilty to the charges.

Lindsay Clancy, 36, is charged with the murders of her three children. The livestreamed trial has captured national and international media attention, and drawn strong, often deeply divided reactions from audiences.

During Light's appearance in the court on Wednesday, Massachusetts lawyers said the sanctity of the judicial system was at risk because of her actions.

Light, a registered nurse with no prior criminal record, was ordered to stay away from the courthouse grounds and also from those associated with the Clancy trial. She was also ordered not to produce or disseminate photos that could have been preserved on iCloud.

Prosecutors requested a $50,000 (£37,000) cash bail, which was denied by the judge.

"This is a complete misunderstanding, Your Honour. My client was trying to get a picture of Ms Clancy," Light's attorney Jennifer White said in court.

After the arraignment, a swarm of reporters gathered around Light. When one asked, "Why did you want to see Lindsay [Clancy]", Light replied, "Why not?".

Authorities said they found Light in a restricted area in her parked car on Tuesday. When asked if she was taking videos, she said she was not and explained that she was waiting for Clancy.

Prosecutors alleged that when they went through Light's deleted folder on her phone, they found photos of jurors exiting the courthouse, and Light was then taken into custody.

Prosecutors said the courthouse has taken extensive measures to protect the trial that has created a spectacle in the coastal Massachusetts town. They described Light's conduct as a serious matter.

Judge William Sullivan, who is overseeing the Clancy trial, has an order specifically prohibiting the photographing or filming of jurors.

There are more than 200 reporters covering the case, and a group of women supporters - ebbing and flowing in size - have been coming to the courthouse over the past few weeks.

The case has also drawn wide attention on social media, stoking broader debates around mental health, postpartum psychosis, and the limits of criminal responsibility.

The Plymouth, Massachusetts, jury has been deliberating since Thursday over whether Clancy is criminally responsible for killing her children.

Despite the enormous media footprint, jurors deliberating the case are barred from watching or reading coverage of the trial. They are tasked with agreeing on a...
body.zh: 一名女子因在林赛·克兰西案审判中在法院外拍摄陪审团成员的照片而被捕，她被指控犯有严重恐吓陪审员的罪名。 56 岁的道恩·莱特 (Dawn Light) 被指控坐在普利茅斯法院外的禁区，并在陪审员离开法院时拍摄他们的照片。她的律师称这是一场误会，因为她对这些指控表示不认罪。 36 岁的林赛·克兰西 (Lindsay Clancy) 被指控谋杀了她的三个孩子。现场直播的审判吸引了国内外媒体的关注，并引起了观众强烈且往往存在深刻分歧的反应。 在莱特周三出庭期间，马萨诸塞州的律师表示，司法系统的神圣性因她的行为而受到威胁。 莱特是一名注册护士，之前没有犯罪记录，他被命令远离法院场地以及与克兰西审判有关的人员。她还被命令不得制作或传播可能保存在 iCloud 上的照片。 检察官要求 50,000 美元（37,000 英镑）现金保释，但被法官拒绝。 “法官大人，这完全是一场误会。我的当事人试图拍一张克兰西女士的照片，”莱特的律师詹妮弗·怀特在法庭上说。 传讯结束后，莱特周围聚集了一大群记者。当有人问“你为什么想见林赛[克兰西]”时，莱特回答说：“为什么不呢？”。 当局表示，周二他们在莱特停放的汽车的禁区内发现了她。当被问及是否在拍摄视频时，她说没有，并解释说她在等克兰西。 检察官声称，当他们检查莱特手机上已删除的文件夹时，他们发现了陪审员离开法院的照片，然后莱特被拘留。 检察官表示，法院已采取广泛措施来保护在马萨诸塞州沿海小镇造成轰动的审判。他们称莱特的行为是一件严重的事情。 负责监督克兰西案审判的法官威廉·沙利文有一项命令，明确禁止对陪审员拍照或录像。 有超过 200 名记者报道此案，过去几周，一批人数不断变化的女性支持者不断来到法院。 该案还在社交媒体上引起了广泛关注，引发了围绕心理健康、产后精神病和刑事责任限制的更广泛辩论。 马萨诸塞州普利茅斯的陪审团自周四以来一直在审议克兰西是否对杀害孩子负有刑事责任。 尽管媒体报道规模巨大，但审议此案的陪审员仍被禁止观看或阅读审判报道。他们的任务是就一项...达成一致。

reflection.en: In the high-stakes environment of the Lindsay Clancy trial, a woman named Dawn Light faces charges for photographing jurors. This action, deemed intimidation, raises questions about respecting the judicial process and the privacy of those involved. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that 'The first to speak in a lawsuit seems right—until someone comes and...
reflection.zh: 在林赛·克兰西审判的高风险环境中，一位名叫唐恩·莱特的女士因拍摄陪审员而被指控。此举被视为恐吓，引发了对尊重司法程序和涉案人员隐私的质疑。《箴言》18:17 提醒我们：“在讼词 المب辩之初，先开口的似乎有理，但对方来了，就审问他。”这一原则强调了在法律事务中需要公平和审慎考量，确保所有各方都能被听到，并且司法程序本身不被外部压力或行为所损害。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: South African airline behind daring stadium stunt cancels next flyby, regulator says
title.zh: 南非航空公司取消了下一次飞行表演，监管机构称其为大胆的体育场特技

summary.en: South Africa's civil aviation authority is investigating an aerial display that took place last Saturday and has confirmed that the airline responsible has cancelled a planned flyby for this weekend.
summary.zh: 南非民航局正在调查上周六举行的空中表演，并已确认负责的航空公司已取消了本周末的计划飞行。

body.en:
The South African airline behind a daring aerial stunt last Saturday that saw two planes flying in close formation low over a packed stadium has pulled out of doing a similar operation this weekend, the country's aviation regulator, SACAA, has said.

Airlink's flying feat divided opinion with some labelling the startling manoeuvre reckless, while others praised the precision and expertise on display.

SACAA said that while it had approved the applications and safety measures for the flybys, it was now investigating further following "discussions in the media".

Airlink has not commented on the reported cancellation of Saturday's display that had been due to place over a stadium in Soweto.

Footage of last weekend's air show before the start of a rugby match in Cape Town, featuring fierce rivals South Africa and New Zealand, was shared around the world.

The flight tracking website Flightradar24 said that according to its analysis "the lead aircraft passed less than 50ft (15m) above the top of the stadium".

From some angles the jets appeared very close to the roof of the DHL Stadium as they roared over amid coloured flare smoke.

The airline said the flights were performed with the "approved and rehearsed safety altitude and speed limits for the flypast" and were conducted by a "highly experienced crew".

But Airlink will not be repeating the flights over the stadium in Soweto, Johannesburg, that is hosting the third and deciding test between the Springboks and the All Blacks, according to SACAA.

The regulator said that while the company had followed all the correct procedures it had now "obtained the flight data recording downloads as well as other additional requirements" for further analysis.

"SACAA, as the safety net of the South African skies, gives the public the assurance that aviation safety and security compliance will always remain paramount and is not negotiable," it said in a statement emphasising the excellent air safety record in the country.

The flyby has been a feature at major sporting and presidential events in South Africa several times over the years - using both military jets and commercial airlines.
body.zh: 南非航空监管机构 SACAA 表示，上周六，南非航空公司进行了一次大胆的空中特技表演，两架飞机在拥挤的体育场上空以紧密编队低空飞行，该航空公司本周末已停止进行类似的行动。 Airlink 的飞行壮举意见不一，一些人认为这一令人震惊的动作是鲁莽的，而另一些人则赞扬了所展示的精确性和专业知识。 SACAA表示，虽然它已经批准了飞越的申请和安全措施，但在“媒体讨论”后，它现在正在进一步调查。 Airlink 尚未对周六的表演被取消的报道发表评论，该表演原定在索韦托的一个体育场上空进行。 上周末在开普敦举行的橄榄球比赛开始前的飞行表演片段在全世界传播，比赛双方是激烈的对手南非和新西兰。 航班跟踪网站Flightradar24表示，根据其分析，“领头飞机飞过体育场顶部不到50英尺（15m）”。 从某些角度看，这些喷气式飞机在彩色耀斑烟雾中呼啸而过，看起来非常靠近 DHL 体育场的屋顶。 该航空公司表示，这些飞行是在“经过批准和排练的飞越安全高度和速度限制”下进行的，并由“经验丰富的机组人员”进行。 但据 SACAA 称，Airlink 将不会重复飞越约翰内斯堡索韦托体育场的航班，该体育场正在举办跳羚队和全黑队之间的第三次决定性测试。 监管机构表示，虽然该公司遵循了所有正确的程序，但现在已经“获得了飞行数据记录下载以及其他附加要求”以进行进一步分析。 南非航空管理局在一份声明中表示，“南非航空管理局作为南非天空的安全网，向公众保证航空安全和安保合规始终至关重要，不容谈判”，强调了该国出色的航空安全记录。 多年来，这次飞越活动多次成为南非重大体育和总统活动的一大特色——使用军用飞机和商业航空公司。

reflection.en: The daring aerial maneuver over a packed stadium sparked immediate debate, with reactions ranging from condemnation to praise. This highlights how quickly public opinion can form, sometimes without full understanding. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that 'The first to speak in a dispute sounds convincing, until someone else comes and probes deeper.' In situations...
reflection.zh: 在挤满观众的体育场上空进行的惊险空中机动表演立即引发了争论，反应从谴责到赞扬不等。这凸显了公众舆论形成的速度之快，有时甚至没有完全理解。箴言 18:17 提醒我们：“在争讼的事上，先开口的似乎有理，但邻舍 Comes and 探究。”...

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
title.zh: 欧盟和北约誓言在德国“新升级”后加大对俄压力

summary.en: Following Germany's accusation of Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport, NATO and the European Commission have warned of Russia's increasing recklessness and pledged to respond faster and better to a 'new normal' of escalation on EU soil.
summary.zh: 在德国指控俄罗斯发动了对莱比锡机场的无人机袭击失败后，北约和欧盟委员会警告俄罗斯日益鲁莽，并誓言要更快、更好地应对欧盟领土上“新常态”的升级。

body.en:
The heads of Nato and the European Commission have warned that Russia is growing increasingly reckless and vowed to respond to a "new normal".

"Leipzig marks a new escalation on European Union soil directly attributed to Russia," said Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, a day after Germany blamed Russia for a failed drone attack last month on Leipzig airport.

"We have to step up and that means being ready to respond to Russia's recklessness faster and better," von der Leyen said. Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte said the whole alliance, which includes the US, stood "in full solidarity with Germany".

Russia has rejected German accusations that a drone carrying explosives deliberately targeted a Ukrainian cargo plane on 4 August.

The drone was defused by a robot at Leipzig/Halle airport and a second drone is thought to have collided with another cargo plane.

A third drone was reportedly found 10 days later at the airport, which is an important Nato hub and is regularly used by Ukrainian Antonov transport aircraft.

It was not until Tuesday that the German government said police investigations and intelligence finding had proved that Russia was behind the incidents.

The interior minister said that the drone's configuration, components, explosives and detonator were all known from other Russian hybrid operations.

Two suspects have reportedly been identified in the Leipzig attack, including a Belarusian with a Russian passport who entered on a tourist visa, and another with Latvian and Russian passports who arrived by plane in Berlin and flew out two days before the failed attack.

Berlin has said it will close the Russian consulate in Bonn as well as the Russian House cultural institution, widely suspected in Berlin of acting as a propaganda outlet for the Kremlin.

The Russian foreign ministry promised to respond in "mirror-image" fashion and said Berlin had offered no evidence to back its claims. Germany's chargé d'affaires Bernd Finke was summoned to hear Moscow's rejection of Berlin's "entirely unfounded accusations".

Vladimir Putin has condemned Germany's measures as a serious mistake that "clearly runs counter to the interests of the German people".

Asked whether Moscow would be prepared to sever relations with Berlin, Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Alexander Grushko answered "maybe", but said for now it was giving diplomacy a chance.

Critics in Germany suggested the German response was relatively weak, but Berlin has its eye on a more co-ordinated response with its allies, including extended EU sanctions and entry restrictions on Russian visitors across the bloc.

Von der Leyen was clear in her statement that the Leipzig attack had involved "military-grade material carried out by Russian operatives on European Union...
body.zh: 北约和欧盟委员会领导人警告称，俄罗斯变得越来越鲁莽，并誓言应对“新常态”。 欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，“莱比锡事件标志着欧盟领土上的一次新的升级，直接归因于俄罗斯。”一天前，德国指责俄罗斯对上个月莱比锡机场发生的无人机袭击失败负责。 冯德莱恩表示：“我们必须挺身而出，这意味着准备好更快、更好地应对俄罗斯的鲁莽行为。”北约秘书长马克·吕特表示，包括美国在内的整个联盟“完全声援德国”。 俄罗斯否认了德国关于 8 月 4 日一架携带爆炸物的无人机故意瞄准一架乌克兰货机的指控。 这架无人机在莱比锡/哈雷机场被机器人拆除，第二架无人机据信与另一架货机相撞。 据报道，十天后在机场发现了第三架无人机，该机场是北约的重要枢纽，乌克兰安东诺夫运输机经常使用。 直到周二，德国政府才表示，警方调查和情报发现证明俄罗斯是这些事件的幕后黑手。 内政部长表示，这架无人机的配置、部件、炸药和雷管都是从俄罗斯其他混合行动中得知的。 据报道，莱比锡袭击事件中有两名嫌疑人已被确认，其中一名持有俄罗斯护照的白俄罗斯人持旅游签证入境，另一名持有拉脱维亚和俄罗斯护照的人乘飞机抵达柏林，并在袭击失败前两天飞出。 柏林表示将关闭俄罗斯驻波恩领事馆以及俄罗斯之家文化机构，柏林广泛怀疑该机构充当克里姆林宫的宣传渠道。 俄罗斯外交部承诺以“镜像”方式做出回应，并表示柏林方面没有提供任何证据支持其说法。德国临时代办贝恩德·芬克被传唤，听取莫斯科对柏林“毫无根据的指控”的驳斥。 弗拉基米尔·普京谴责德国的措施是一个严重错误，“明显违背了德国人民的利益”。 当被问及莫斯科是否准备与柏林断绝关系时，俄罗斯副外长亚历山大·格鲁什科回答“也许”，但表示目前正在给外交机会。 德国的批评者表示，德国的反应相对较弱，但柏林希望与其盟友采取更加协调一致的反应，包括扩大欧盟制裁以及对整个欧盟的俄罗斯游客实施入境限制。 冯德莱恩在声明中明确表示，莱比锡袭击涉及“俄罗斯特工对欧盟制造的军事级材料......

reflection.en: The escalating tensions between Russia and the EU, marked by the Leipzig drone incident, present a stark reminder of the fragility of peace. The call to 'step up' and respond to 'recklessness' underscores the difficult path of navigating conflict while striving for diplomatic solutions. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and the pursuit of...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯与欧盟之间日益紧张的局势，以莱比锡无人机事件为标志，严峻地提醒着和平的脆弱性。“加大应对”和回应“鲁莽行为”的呼吁，凸显了在寻求外交解决方案的同时，应对冲突的艰难道路。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势，追求持久和平，而非进一步陷入敌对。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Macron visits Bayeux Tapestry with King Charles, PM Andy Burnham
title.zh: 马克龙与国王查尔斯、首相安迪·伯纳姆一同参观贝叶挂毯

summary.en: French President Emmanuel Macron began a two-day trip to the UK by viewing the 11th-century Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum with King Charles III and Prime Minister Andy Burnham. The tapestry, on loan from France, is 70 meters long. King Charles described the loan as a 'precious symbol of trust' between the UK...
summary.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙开始为期两天的英国之行，他在大英博物馆与英国国王查尔斯三世和首相安迪·伯纳姆一同参观了11世纪的贝叶挂毯。这幅挂毯是法国的借展品，长70米。查尔斯国王称此次借展是英法之间“信任的宝贵象征”。

body.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 对英国的访问时间比著名的租借的 11 世纪挂毯要短。他与英国君主和新任首相安迪·伯纳姆一起参观了这些古代艺术品。 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙开始了为期两天的英国之行，与国王查理三世和首相安迪·伯纳姆一起参观了另一位来自法国的著名新来者贝叶挂毯。 马克龙和他的妻子布丽吉特、伯纳姆和他的妻子玛丽-弗朗斯·范·希尔与查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后一起走过大英博物馆 70 米长的挂毯。 查尔斯称赞这笔“史无前例的贷款”是英国和法国之间“信任的宝贵象征”，而马克龙则表示两国“就像艺术品中的线一样亲密”。 这幅挂毯描绘了 1066 年诺曼底征服者威廉夺取英国王位的重大事件，是从其通常所在地法国临时借出的。自 11 世纪诞生以来，这是它首次踏入英国土地。 这些刺绣品已被租借用于下周（即 9 月 10 日）向公众开放的为期 10 个月的展览。此次交换是在去年马克龙进行国事访问期间首次宣布的。 尽管人们认为它是在不列颠群岛制造的，但它自 11 世纪以来就一直在法国土​​地上生产。它通常在法国北部诺曼底的贝叶展出，因此得名。这件实际上无价的文物于七月秘密穿越英吉利海峡。 六周前上任的总理伯纳姆称挂毯的回归是两国历史上的“一个里程碑式的时刻”。 周三，他还在下议院普遍赞扬了与马克龙法国政府的关系，暗示减少了英吉利海峡的非法移民——此举是为了反驳英国改革派夏季最喜欢的话题之一。 伯纳姆说：“借出挂毯是法英合作的一个很好的例子——同样的合作帮助我们将夏季小船过境量减少到七年来的最低水平。” 这是伯纳姆上任以来马克龙首次访问英国，也是他们作为领导人的第一次面对面会面。 贝叶挂毯是一件 70 米长的艺术品，被认为是不完整的，描绘了 1066 年诺曼征服英格兰。 由征服者威廉领导的诺曼军队在一场战役中击败并废黜了哈罗德·戈德温森国王，最终在黑斯廷斯战役中取得了胜利。挂毯上著名的描绘了哈罗德被箭射中眼睛，据说他已经死了——诚然，现代历史学家认为这可能是神话或艺术夸张。 这次征服是一个关键的贡献时刻......

reflection.en: The visit of President Macron, King Charles, and Prime Minister Burnham to the Bayeux Tapestry brings together leaders from different nations and roles. Their presence underscores the public trust placed in them to govern justly and serve their people, a responsibility echoed in Jeremiah's call for rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness.' May they,...
reflection.zh: 马克龙总统、查尔斯国王和安迪·伯纳姆首相参观贝叶挂毯的访问，汇聚了来自不同国家和角色的领导人。他们的出席突显了公众对他们公正治理和为人民服务的信任，这一责任在耶利米呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义”的经文中得到了呼应。愿他们以及所有领导人都能牢记维护公平和保护弱者的职责。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: US sanctions halt TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, disrupting study plans
title.zh: 美国制裁叫停伊朗托福和GRE考试，打乱留学计划

summary.en: Students in Iran are unable to take TOEFL and GRE exams due to the suspension of a US sanctions exemption. Applicants report that this decision jeopardizes their university application deadlines and imposes costly travel requirements.
summary.zh: 由于美国制裁豁免被暂停，伊朗学生无法参加托福和GRE考试。申请者表示，此举威胁到他们的大学申请截止日期，并增加了昂贵的旅行负担。

body.en:
Students in Iran can no longer take TOEFL and GRE exams after a US sanctions exemption was suspended. Applicants say the move threatens university deadlines and adds costly travel obligations.

Iranian students hoping to study abroad are facing a new obstacle after TOEFL and GRE testing was suspended inside the country following changes to US sanctions regulations .

"My entire plan was built around taking this exam," a TOEFL candidate in Tehran told DW.

She said she had spent months preparing applications for a PhD program, contacting professors and gathering documents despite internet disruptions and other challenges.

ETS, the US-based organization that administers both exams, announced it suspended testing in Iran after the US Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) froze General License G, which had allowed certain educational services to continue in Iran .

"Following OFAC's suspension of General License G, ETS has paused administration of the TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran effective immediately," the organization said in an official notice.

ETS added that Iranian nationals can still take the exams outside Iran and that it is exploring options to restore testing.

TOEFL is a US-based English-language proficiency test accepted by universities worldwide. The GRE is a standardized test required by some graduate programs, particularly in the United States and Canada.

Since the  Iran war  began in late February, the US has increasingly expanded sanctions targeting Iranian trade and exports, contributing to broader disruptions throughout the Iranian economy .

An Iranian institution that administered TOEFL exams told DW that new registrations had stopped following the latest sanctions changes .

The institution added that the suspension could be temporary, but no date had been given for exams to resume.

That uncertainty is particularly serious for students approaching university and scholarship deadlines who have spent months preparing and paying application-related costs.

The suspension follows earlier problems with IELTS (British equivalent of TOEFL) testing in Iran. An IELTS center in Tehran  told DW that sanctions-related difficulties transferring money had become one of the main obstacles to continuing exams.

Some Iranian applicants had already been traveling to countries such as Turkey and Armenia to take IELTS. TOEFL and GRE candidates may now have to do the same.

Alireza, who is preparing to apply to a university in Italy, said the suspension of TOEFL had disrupted a backup plan he had arranged after IELTS testing became unavailable.

"European universities usually accept IELTS. But because IELTS has been suspended in Iran, after extensive correspondence with the university, they agreed...
body.zh: 在美国制裁豁免暂停后，伊朗的学生不能再参加托福和GRE考试。申请人表示，此举威胁到大学的最后期限，并增加了昂贵的旅行义务。希望出国留学的伊朗学生在美国制裁法规变更后，托福和GRE考试在国内暂停后面临新的障碍。“我的整个计划都是围绕着参加这次考试制定的，”德黑兰的一名托福考生告诉DW。她说，尽管互联网中断和其他挑战，她还是花了几个月的时间准备博士学位课程的申请，联系教授并收集文件。管理这两项考试的美国组织ETS宣布，在美国财政部外国资产控制办公室（ OFAC ）冻结通用许可证G后，它暂停了在伊朗的考试，该许可证允许某些教育服务继续在伊朗进行。“在OFAC暂停通用许可证G之后， ETS已暂停在伊朗进行托福和GRE考试，立即生效，”该组织在一份官方通知中表示。ETS补充说，伊朗国民仍然可以在伊朗境外参加考试，并且正在探索恢复测试的选项。托福是全球各大学接受的美国英语水平考试。GRE也由同一个美国组织管理，是一些研究生课程要求的标准化考试，特别是在美国和加拿大。自2月下旬伊朗战争开始以来，美国越来越多地扩大针对伊朗贸易和出口的制裁，导致整个伊朗经济出现更广泛的混乱。一家管理托福考试的伊朗机构告诉德国之声，在最近的制裁变更后，新的注册已经停止。该机构补充说，暂停考试可能是暂时的，但没有给出恢复考试的日期。对于接近大学和奖学金截止日期的学生来说，这种不确定性尤其严重，他们花了数月时间准备文件，联系教授并支付与申请相关的费用。此前，伊朗雅思（英国相当于托福）考试出现了问题。德黑兰雅思考试中心告诉德国之声，与制裁有关的转账困难已成为继续考试的主要障碍之一。一些伊朗申请人已经前往土耳其和亚美尼亚等国家参加雅思考试。托福和GRE考生现在可能必须做同样的事情。准备申请意大利一所大学的Alireza表示，暂停托福考试打乱了他在雅思考试不可用后安排的备考计划。“欧洲大学通常接受雅思考试。但由于雅思考试已被暂停...

reflection.en: The suspension of TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, a consequence of US sanctions, leaves many students in a difficult position, threatening their academic timelines and forcing them to incur additional expenses. These students, who have worked diligently to prepare their applications, find their voices unheard and their futures uncertain due to decisions made...
reflection.zh: 美国制裁暂停了伊朗的托福和GRE考试，这使得许多学生陷入困境，威胁到他们的学业时间表，并迫使他们承担额外费用。这些学生辛勤准备申请材料，却发现自己的声音被忽视，未来变得不确定，这一切都源于远方的决定。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者辨明是非”。这段经文提醒我们要为那些机会受到不公正限制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Guinea-Bissau referendum tests democratic future
title.zh: 几内亚比绍公投考验民主未来

summary.en: Following voter approval of a constitutional change that expands presidential powers, Guinea-Bissau faces renewed debate over legitimacy, civilian rule and democratic safeguards.
summary.zh: 在选民批准了一项扩大总统权力的宪法修正案后，几内亚比绍面临着关于合法性、文官统治和民主保障的新一轮辩论。

body.en:
Following voter approval of a constitutional change that expands presidential powers, Guinea-Bissau faces renewed debate over legitimacy, civilian rule and democratic safeguards.

Guinea-Bissau is facing a new political test after voters approved a referendum on a proposed charter that will give the president the power to appoint and dismiss the prime minister and government ministers, while reducing the number of seats in parliament from 102 to 65..

Sunday's referendum came less than 10 months after a coup in which the military seized power and three months ahead of presidential and parliamentary elections scheduled to take place on December 6.

The transitional authorities say the constitutional reform is intended to bring stability to the impoverished West African country and prepare it for a return to civilian rule.

On Monday, the National Transitional Council claimed victory for the "Yes" camp. "The majority of those who went to vote voted yes. In conclusion, the victory of yes is guaranteed," council spokesman Alberto Pinto Pereira said.

On Tuesday, the National Electoral Commission (NEC) confirmed victory for the "Yes" side, saying it had received 70% of the vote, compared with 30% for the "No" camp, and that voter turnout exceeded 50%.

NEC chairperson Carmen Izaura Lobo described the Guinea-Bissau referendum as a success, due to the "organizational capacity, professionalism and dedication" of teams on the ground, Agence France-Presse (AFP) reported.

The opposition, however, says the referendum has no legal basis because it was organized by institutions created after the military coup . It had called on voters to boycott the vote.

Domingos Simoes Pereira, leader of the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (PAIGC), who was  detained after the military coup and later released into house arrest , rejected the referendum as legally invalid.

Speaking to DW from Portugal, he said the institutions established by the military have no democratic mandate to rewrite Guinea-Bissau's constitution.

The PAIGC and other opposition groups maintain that the vote is a continuation of the November coup.

Fernando Dias Costa, the main challenger to then-President Umaro Sissoco Embalo in the November 2025 presidential election that was annulled by the military, disputed the official turnout figures.

"Very few citizens took part in this referendum," he said, noting that the people have sent an important message that must not be ignored.

"They are not prepared to simply accept political changes that are clearly unconstitutional and have not been publicly debated."

The proposed constitution would move Guinea-Bissau toward a much stronger presidential system. The president would appoint and dismiss the prime minister and...
body.zh: 在选民批准扩大总统权力的宪法修正案后，几内亚比绍面临着关于合法性、文官统治和民主保障的新辩论。 几内亚比绍正面临新的政治考验，选民批准了对拟议宪章的全民公投，该宪章将赋予总统任命和罢免总理和政府部长的权力，同时将议会席位从102个减少到65个。 周日的公投是在军方夺取政权的政变发生后不到 10 个月举行的，距离定于 12 月 6 日举行的总统和议会选举还有三个月。 过渡当局表示，宪法改革的目的是为这个贫穷的西非国家带来稳定，并为恢复文官统治做好准备。 On Monday, the National Transitional Council claimed victory for the "Yes" camp. “大多数去投票的人都投了赞成票。总之，赞成票的胜利是有保证的，”议会发言人阿尔贝托·平托·佩雷拉说。 周二，国家选举委员会（NEC）确认“赞成”阵营获胜，称其获得了70%的选票，而“反对”阵营则只有30%，投票率超过了50%。 据法新社报道，国家选举委员会主席卡门·伊扎乌拉·洛博 (Carmen Izaura Lobo) 表示，几内亚比绍公投取得了成功，这要归功于当地团队的“组织能力、专业精神和奉献精神”。 The opposition, however, says the referendum has no legal basis because it was organized by institutions created after the military coup . It had called on voters to boycott the vote. 几内亚和佛得角非洲独立党 (PAIGC) 领导人多明戈斯·西莫斯·佩雷拉 (Domingos Simoes Pereira) 在军事政变后被拘留，后来被软禁，他拒绝接受公投，认为公投在法律上无效。 他在葡萄牙接受德国之声采访时表示，军方建立的机构没有民主授权重写几内亚比绍宪法。 The PAIGC and other opposition groups maintain that the vote is a continuation of the November coup. 费尔南多·迪亚斯·科斯塔 (Fernando Dias Costa) 是时任总统乌马罗·西索科·恩巴洛 (Umaro Sissoco Embalo) 在被军方取消的 2025 年 11 月总统选举中的主要挑战者，他对官方投票率数据提出异议。 "Very few citizens took part in this referendum," he said, noting that the people have sent an important message that must not be ignored. "They are not prepared to simply accept political changes that are clearly unconstitutional and have not been publicly debated." The proposed constitution would move Guinea-Bissau toward a much stronger presidential system. The president would appoint and dismiss the prime minister and...

reflection.en: Guinea-Bissau's recent referendum, which shifts power towards the presidency by reducing parliamentary seats and granting the president authority over ministerial appointments, raises concerns about democratic safeguards. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that the stability and well-being of a nation are deeply tied to the character and actions of its rulers, urging...
reflection.zh: 几内亚比绍最近的公投，通过减少议会席位并授予总统任命部长的权力，将权力向总统转移，这引发了对民主保障的担忧。《箴言》29:2提醒我们，国家的稳定和福祉与其统治者的品格和行为息息相关，因此需要警惕权力的平衡和对文官统治的保护。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: India rejects Hague ruling on Indus waters: What's next?
title.zh: 印度驳回海牙裁决，下一步是什么？

summary.en: India has rejected a ruling by an international arbitration panel regarding the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty, casting doubt on the treaty's future. New Delhi described the tribunal as a "so-called Court of Arbitration" that was "illegally constituted."
summary.zh: 印度驳回了国际仲裁小组关于1960年《印度河流域条约》的裁决，这给该条约的未来蒙上了阴影。新德里称该仲裁庭为“所谓的仲裁法院”，并称其“非法组成”。

body.en:
By rejecting an international arbitration panel's ruling, New Delhi has cast fresh doubt on the future of the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty.

The Indus Waters Treaty is facing a fresh dispute after India rejected a Hague-based Court of Arbitration ruling that the 1960 agreement remains in force.   

India's Ministry of External Affairs described the tribunal as a "so-called Court of Arbitration" that was "illegally constituted."

It said the body had been established by the World Bank in breach of the treaty and that India "categorically rejects its so-called award, just as it has firmly rejected all prior pronouncements by this illegally constituted body."

"The Court of Arbitration has no jurisdiction whatsoever to pronounce on India's sovereign decisions," the ministry said.

The Indus Waters Treaty, brokered by the World Bank, governs the use of water from six rivers flowing through India and Pakistan.

The agreement largely gives India rights over three eastern rivers while Pakistan has rights over the western Indus, Jhelum and Chenab. India is allowed to use the western rivers for specified purposes including certain hydroelectric projects.

The treaty had endured wars and prolonged periods of intense hostility between the two nuclear-armed neighbors.

But India placed the treaty in abeyance in April 2025 as part of a package of diplomatic and economic measures announced after a deadly attack in India-administered Kashmir killed 26 people, mostly tourists.

Millions of people in Pakistan depend on the Indus, Jhelum and Chenab rivers for drinking water, farming and daily life.

The rivers are particularly important to Punjab and Sindh provinces, whose agriculture is central to the country's food supply and rural economy.

After India's move to suspend the treaty, Pakistan approached the court in The Hague over the status of the accord.

Pakistani officials have repeatedly warned that any attempt to deny the country its share of the waters of rivers flowing across the border would be treated as an act of war.

Ajay Bisaria, a former Indian high commissioner to Pakistan, said India had challenged the treaty on both political and legal grounds.

"Politically, abeyance hands India a new point of leverage, one more lever to press Pakistan into changing its behavior on cross-border terrorism," Bisaria told DW.

He also pointed to India's earlier requests to renegotiate the treaty, citing climate change, new dam-building technology and the deterioration of relations between the two countries.

India chose to put the treaty in abeyance rather than formally abrogate it. Bisaria said the Hague ruling would not change that course.

body.zh: 通过拒绝国际仲裁小组的裁决，新德里对 1960 年《印度河水域条约》的未来产生了新的怀疑。 印度拒绝海牙仲裁法院关于 1960 年协议仍然有效的裁决后，印度河水域条约面临新的争议。 印度外交部将该仲裁庭描述为“非法成立”的“所谓仲裁法院”。 声明称，该机构是世界银行设立的，违反了条约，印度“断然拒绝其所谓的裁决，就像它坚决拒绝这个非法成立的机构之前的所有声明一样”。 该部表示：“仲裁法院对印度的主权决定没有任何管辖权。” 由世界银行促成的《印度河水域条约》管理流经印度和巴基斯坦的六条河流的水的使用。 该协议主要赋予印度对东部三条河流的权利，而巴基斯坦则拥有对西部印度河、杰赫勒姆河和杰纳布河的权利。印度被允许将​​西部河流用于特定目的，包括某些水力发电项目。 该条约经历了这两个拥有核武器的邻国之间的战争和长期的激烈敌对。 但印度于 2025 年 4 月暂停该条约，作为印控克什米尔发生致命袭击导致 26 人死亡（其中大部分是游客）后宣布的一揽子外交和经济措施的一部分。 巴基斯坦数百万人依赖印度河、杰赫勒姆河和杰纳布河获取饮用水、耕作和日常生活。 这些河流对旁遮普省和信德省尤为重要，这两个省的农业是该国粮食供应和农村经济的核心。 印度暂停该条约后，巴基斯坦就该协议的地位向海牙法院提起诉讼。 巴基斯坦官员一再警告称，任何试图剥夺该国分享跨境河流水域份额的行为都将被视为战争行为。 印度前驻巴基斯坦高级专员阿贾伊·比萨里亚表示，印度从政治和法律角度对该条约提出了挑战。 比萨里亚告诉德国之声：“从政治上讲，暂停为印度提供了一个新的杠杆点，一个迫使巴基斯坦改变其跨境恐怖主义行为的又一个杠杆。” 他还提到印度早些时候要求重新谈判该条约，理由是气候变化、新的水坝建设技术以及两国关系恶化。 印度选择暂时搁置该条约，而不是正式废除该条约。比萨里亚表示，海牙裁决不会改变这一方针。 “法庭不会改变这一轨迹，”他说。 "India's course on the Indus Waters Treaty is set. The...

reflection.en: The future of the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty is uncertain after India rejected an international arbitration ruling, calling the tribunal "illegally constituted." This stance raises questions about how nations can navigate disputes and maintain treaties when fundamental disagreements arise about the process itself. The call to "live at peace with everyone, if...
reflection.zh: 在印度拒绝一项国际仲裁裁决并称该仲裁庭“非法组成”之后，1960年《印度河流域条约》的未来变得不确定。这一立场引发了关于当国家在程序本身上存在根本分歧时，如何处理争端和维持条约的疑问。“若可行，总要尽力与众人和睦”（罗马书12:18）这节经文提醒我们，即使在信任受到考验时，也要寻求对话和解决的途径。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

reflection.en: The leaders of Pacific island nations are navigating complex geopolitical currents, yet their urgent pleas to Australia highlight their immediate concerns: climate change and the drug trade. These are matters of justice and well-being for their people, echoing the prophet Micah's call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Their focus on...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正驾驭复杂的地缘政治暗流，但他们向澳大利亚发出的紧急呼吁，凸显了他们眼前的关切：气候变化和毒品交易。这些关乎其人民的福祉和公义，呼应了先知弥迦的呼召，要行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。他们关注切实的需要而非遥远的冲突，提醒我们真正的优先事项往往在哪里。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: US warship arrives in Thailand after record 286 days at sea
title.zh: 美国军舰在海上创纪录航行286天后抵达泰国

summary.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier arrived in Thailand after a record 286 consecutive days at sea. The extended deployment, which included time in the Middle East and participation in combat operations during the war with Iran, reportedly led to mental health concerns among the approximately 5,000 sailors and...
summary.zh: 美国海军航空母舰“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号在海上连续航行286天，创下纪录后抵达泰国。此次延长的部署任务包括在中东地区停留，并参与了与伊朗的战争中的战斗行动。据报道，船上约5000名海军和海军陆战队员因此出现了心理健康问题。

body.en:
The United States Navy aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrived at Thailand's Laem Chabang port on Wednesday after spending 286 consecutive days at sea.

The record-long deployment included an extended period in the Middle East, amid reports of mounting mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard the vessel.

The carrier, which has around 5,000 sailors and marines on board, was deployed in November last year and took part in the US naval blockade and combat operations during the war with Iran.

US Navy deployments typically last between six and nine months, although they can be extended during periods of conflict.

This deployment set a modern-era record for consecutive days at sea, according to US officials.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Abraham Lincoln, accompanied by other US naval vessels, will spend five days in Thailand for rest and recuperation, according to Thai officials.

"Our arrival in Laem Chabang provides a well-deserved opportunity for our Sailors and Marines to rest and recharge. It also underscores the strong and enduring partnership and alliance between the United States and Thailand," the commander of Carrier Strike Group 3, Rear Admiral Robert E. Loughran, said in a statement.

"What this strike group has accomplished is truly historic. I could not be prouder of the exceptional professionalism and expertise demonstrated by every member of this team during our operations."

Thailand became a US treaty ally in 1954, before being designated a major non-NATO ally in 2003. Thailand's armed forces have long been reliant on US defence hardware and both countries' militaries maintain strong relations and hold annual exercises together.

Thailand has made it clear the visit is for logistics, rest, and recuperation, in line with its treaty commitments, and is not connected to the conflict in the Middle East.

The arrival of thousands of military personnel has raised hopes of an economic boost for the nearby ‌resort city of Pattaya, which also has a longstanding reputation as a sex tourism destination.

A fleet of around 40 buses will ferry the military personnel between Pattaya and the port at Laem Chabang where the vessels will dock, Pattaya Mayor Poramase Ngampiches said. Pattaya sits on the Gulf of Thailand, about 150km southeast of Bangkok.

"There are certain places and activities that the personnel are prohibited from participating in, such as all kinds of water sports, jet skiing, bungee jumping, wrestling, and boxing," he told the Reuters news agency.

Police will deploy additional patrols around Pattaya's main beachfront and nightlife district, following raids over the weekend that led to 40 to...
body.zh: 美国海军航空母舰亚伯拉罕·林肯号在连续海上航行286天后于周三抵达泰国林查班港。 这次创纪录的部署时间包括在中东的较长一段时间，有报道称，船上的心理健康问题日益严重，船上的情况不断恶化。 这艘航母载有约5000名水手和海军陆战队员，于去年11月部署，并在与伊朗的战争期间参加了美国的海上封锁和作战行动。 美国海军的部署通常持续六到九个月，但在冲突期间可能会延长。 美国官员称，这次部署创下了海上连续几天的现代记录。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据泰国官员称，亚伯拉罕·林肯号将在其他美国海军舰艇的陪同下在泰国休养五天。 “我们抵达林查班为我们的水手和海军陆战队员提供了一个当之无愧的休息和充电的机会。这也凸显了美国和泰国之间强大而持久的伙伴关系和联盟，”第三航母战斗群司令罗伯特·E·洛夫兰少将在一份声明中说。 “这个打击群所取得的成就确实具有历史意义。我对这个团队的每个成员在行动中所表现出的卓越专业精神和专业知识感到无比自豪。” 泰国于 1954 年成为美国的条约盟友，并于 2003 年被指定为主要的非北约盟友。泰国武装部队长期以来一直依赖美国的国防硬件，两国军队保持着牢固的关系，并每年举行联合演习。 泰国已明确表示，此次访问是为了履行其条约承诺，进行后勤、休息和休养，与中东冲突无关。 数千名军事人员的到来给附近的度假城市芭堤雅带来了经济增长的希望，芭堤雅也素有性旅游目的地的美誉。 芭堤雅市长 Poramase Ngampiches 表示，由约 40 辆巴士组成的车队将在芭堤雅和军舰停靠的林查班港之间运送军事人员。芭堤雅位于泰国湾，距曼谷东南约 150 公里。 他对路透社表示：“有些场所和活动是禁止人员参加的，例如各种水上运动、水上摩托艇、蹦极、摔跤和拳击。” 继周末突袭导致 40 人受伤后，警方将在芭堤雅主要海滨和夜生活区周围部署更多巡逻人员。

reflection.en: After an unprecedented 286 days at sea, the USS Abraham Lincoln has reached port. This extended deployment, reportedly taking a toll on the mental well-being of its 5,000 crew members, highlights the profound exhaustion that prolonged service can bring. Yet, the prophet Isaiah offers a timeless promise: 'those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength.'...
reflection.zh: 在创纪录的286天海上航行后，“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航母终于抵达港口。这次延长的部署任务据报道给船上5000名船员的心理健康带来了影响，凸显了长期服役可能带来的巨大疲惫。然而，先知以赛亚提供了一个永恒的应许：“那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。”愿我们记念那些服役的人们，愿他们能找到安息和重燃的希望。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: 'Miracles do happen': Search and rescue continues as more Australians found alive in Nepal
title.zh: “奇迹确实会发生”：尼泊尔发现更多澳大利亚人生还，搜救仍在继续

summary.en: Four more Australians have been found safe, as hopes fade for survivors as Nepal's flood death toll rises to 1,114. Six Australians have now been located since the floods hit the Nepal-China border last Wednesday, with the number of missing Australians revised down to 38.
summary.zh: 随着尼泊尔洪灾死亡人数升至1114人，幸存者的希望渐灭，又有四名澳大利亚人被找到。自上周三洪水袭击尼泊尔-中国边境以来，已有六名澳大利亚人被找到，失踪的澳大利亚人数已下调至38人。

body.en:
Four more Australians have been confirmed safe in the Nepal-Tibet region following devastating flooding and the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has revised the number of missing Australians down to 38.

At least 1,114 people have been killed in Nepal after a glacial collapse triggered devastating flash floods, with nearly 4,000 people still unaccounted for.

Six Australians have now been located since the floods hit the Nepal-China border last Wednesday. Officials were in contact with an Australian in Tibet on Tuesday after another Australian, Cara Severino, was found safe in Nepal over the weekend.

According to the ABC, one of the four other Australians located was found in Nepal. The remaining three were found outside of the location where the flooding took place. Their welfare is currently not known.

Australian aid supplies aboard a Royal Australian Air Force plane that departed earlier this week were due to arrive in Nepal on Wednesday morning.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Nepali rescue teams are digging, drilling and blasting through debris in a desperate race against time to free around 100 hydropower workers believed trapped in multiple tunnels.

Authorities said 279 people had been rescued from the ruins of hydropower projects, but at least 639 more were still missing, some of whom are believed to be trapped in tunnels.

Specialised rescue teams from India, China and the United States are involved in the tunnel rescue attempts.

"The plan today is to get on a helicopter and go to the hydro tunnels where they believe there's still life," Ferrin Cole, a member of the US crisis response team currently in Nepal, told ANI news agency.

"We have high-technology listening equipment to listen for sounds of life. And then the safety teams to go in and check."

So far, rescuers have recovered only bodies from tunnels blocked by sludge, and hopes of finding survivors are fading, with officials fearing many are buried under debris left by the floods that tore through towns and valleys near the Chinese border.

"The hope of finding survivors is decreasing," Phanindra Paudel, a senior official at the government's National Emergency Operation Center, said via the Reuters news agency.

Excavators worked into the night on Tuesday, but an army update noted that "a large amount of water started flowing" into a hole they were digging, forcing them to start a new opening.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah has called the catastrophe "unimaginable and heartbreaking".

With mortuaries overflowing in Nepal, authorities have begun burying hundreds of unidentified bodies after DNA sampling.

title.en: I've worked with families of missing people for 25 years. Here's how uncertainty feels
title.zh: 我曾与失踪者家属共事25年。我知道不确定性是什么感觉

summary.en: Loved ones of missing people must grapple with the possibility that they may never know for certain what happened. The devastating flash floods in Nepal and Tibet have claimed over 1,000 lives, with at least 42 Australians among more than 4,000 people still unaccounted for. The ambiguity of 'unaccounted for' creates...
summary.zh: 失踪者的亲人必须面对他们可能永远无法确切知道发生了什么的可能。尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的山洪暴发已造成1000多人死亡，其中至少有42名澳大利亚人在4000多名仍“下落不明”的人之列。“下落不明”这个词的模糊性给家属带来了不确定性和绝望之间的痛苦差距，因为无法保证他们会收到消息。

body.en:
The surging death count from the devastating flash floods that hit Nepal and Tibet on 26 August has passed 1,000.

At least 42 Australians are among more than 4,000 people still “unaccounted for”. But this phrase "unaccounted" — frequently used in media reports — can split the problem too simply: people are either lost or yet to be found.

For many families waiting for news, this gap between uncertainty and despair is ambiguous — and it’s agonising. There is no guarantee news will ever come.

So, how can people missing loved ones make sense of this traumatic experience while the search continues? And what kind of support will they need?

I have been working with families of missing people for more than 25 years. Here’s what I’ve learnt about their experiences of ambiguous loss.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Ambiguous loss describes an ongoing loss without a resolution or closure. It can affect how people feel and behave, and the kind of support they will need.

While waiting for news of their loved ones in Nepal and Tibet, people will be grappling with the shock and trauma of how the disappearance unfolded, and the scale of the disaster. They will also be facing uncertainty and fear about how long they will be on this path.

When living with an ambiguous loss, it is common to oscillate between hopeful thinking and moments of hopelessness.

People may feel frozen to the time they learned the news, replay their last conversations with that person, or repetitively think up new ways to search and find them.

Families in Australia may also feel helpless being so far away, especially as the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has asked people to reconsider travelling to the affected areas to look for people who are out of contact. They may feel excluded from searching because they can’t travel to the region.

They may also experience physical and emotional agitation, feel sick in the stomach, or be restless from the need to constantly be on alert for information updates.

When observing how people respond to a missing loved one, it can seem to others that families aren't embracing reality. This might look like clinging to ideas that someone is alive, against the odds, or hoping for a miracle in unlikely circumstances.

This isn’t a family’s decision to not confront the reality, but a normal response to incomprehensible and traumatic situations.

Social workers who work in the field of missing persons learn to encourage families to respond however they need— even if that changes minute by minute.

For many people, surges of hope sustain us in times of crisis and...
body.zh: 8 月 26 日袭击尼泊尔和西藏的毁灭性山洪造成的死亡人数激增，已超过 1000 人。 4000多人仍然“下落不明”，其中至少有42名澳大利亚人。但媒体报道中经常使用的“下落不明”这个词可能会把问题简单化：人们要么失踪了，要么还没有找到。 对于许多等待消息的家庭来说，不确定性和绝望之间的差距是模糊的——而且令人痛苦。无法保证一定会传来消息。 那么，在寻找亲人的过程中，人们如何才能理解这段痛苦的经历呢？他们需要什么样的支持？ 我与失踪人员家属一起工作已超过 25 年。以下是我对他们模糊失落经历的了解。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 不明确的损失描述了一种持续的损失，没有解决或结束。它会影响人们的感受和行为，以及他们需要的支持类型。 在尼泊尔和西藏等待亲人消息的同时，人们将面临失踪事件的发生以及灾难规模带来的震惊和创伤。他们还将面临不确定性和恐惧，不知道自己会在这条道路上走多久。 当生活在模糊的失落之中时，人们通常会在充满希望的想法和绝望的时刻之间摇摆不定。 人们可能会在得知消息时感到冻结，重温与该人的最后一次对话，或者反复想出新的方法来搜索和找到他们。 澳大利亚的家庭也可能会因为距离如此遥远而感到无助，特别是外交和贸易部已要求人们重新考虑前往受影响地区寻找失去联系的人。他们可能会因为无法前往该地区而感到被排除在搜索之外。 他们还可能会感到身体和情绪焦躁、胃部不适，或者因​​需要不断警惕信息更新而焦躁不安。 当观察人们对失踪亲人的反应时，在其他人看来，家庭并没有接受现实。这可能看起来像是坚持认为某人还活着，克服困难，或者希望在不可能的情况下出现奇迹。 这并不是一个家庭决定不面对现实，而是对难以理解和创伤的情况的正常反应。 在失踪人员领域工作的社会工作者学会鼓励家人根据需要做出反应——即使情况每时每刻都在变化。 对于许多人来说，希望的浪潮支撑着我们……

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......
