This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Nepal-Tibet flood deaths pass 1,000 as police ask relatives for DNA to identify victims
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水死亡人数超过1000人，警方要求亲属提供DNA以识别遇难者

summary.en: Relatives of missing tourists were asked for blood samples and photos as rescue efforts continued for hundreds of hydropower workers trapped in the Himalayas. The death toll from devastating floods has surpassed 1,000 nearly a week after the disaster struck towns and valleys across Nepal and Tibet.
summary.zh: 在喜马拉雅山区搜救数百名被困水电站工人的同时，失踪游客的亲属被要求提供血样和照片。在毁灭性洪水袭击尼泊尔和西藏的城镇和山谷近一周后，死亡人数已超过1000人。

body.en: Relatives of missing tourists asked for blood samples and photos, as efforts continue to rescue trapped hydropower workers Nepal-Tibet floods – latest updates Visual guide: How the Nepal-Tibet flash flood unfolded Nepali rescuers have built temporary bridges to reach remote areas and dug through the ruins of hydropower projects in the Himalayas to rescue hundreds of trapped workers, as the death toll passed 1,000 nearly ⁠a week after devastating ​floods left a trail of destruction across the country’s towns and valleys. About 600 people remain stuck in several devastated hydropower stations that have become the focus of rescue efforts. The prime ⁠minister, Balendra Shah, said more than 11,000 people had been rescued across the affected region, and power and communication lines had been restored in some areas. Continue reading...
body.zh: 失踪游客的亲属要求提供血样和照片，同时继续努力营救被困的水电工人。 尼泊尔-西藏洪水——最新动态 视觉指南：尼泊尔-西藏山洪爆发的过程 尼泊尔救援人员建造了临时桥梁，到达偏远地区，并在喜马拉雅山的水电项目废墟中挖掘，以营救数百名被困工人。毁灭性洪水在该国城镇造成严重破坏，近一周后死亡人数已超过 1,000 人。和山谷。几个被毁的水电站仍有约600人被困，这些水电站已成为救援工作的重点。总理巴伦德拉·沙阿 (Balendra Shah) 表示，受影响地区已有 11,000 多人获救，部分地区的电力和通讯线路已恢复。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have claimed over 1,000 lives, leaving a trail of destruction and immense grief. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, 'Jesus wept,' speaks volumes. It shows that divine empathy is present even in our deepest sorrow, acknowledging the pain without offering easy answers.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的洪水已造成1000多人死亡，留下了满目疮痍和巨大的悲痛。在如此深切的失落时刻，圣经中最短的一节经文“耶稣哭了”意义深远。它表明，即使在我们最深的悲伤中，神圣的同情也与我们同在，承认痛苦，却不提供廉价的慰藉。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Nepal-Tibet floods: millions at risk from glacial floods in Himalayas in years to come, UN warns, as death toll passes 1,000 – as it happened
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水：死亡人数超过1000人，救援工作仍在水电站隧道进行——最新消息

summary.en: The death toll from catastrophic flooding in Nepal and Tibet has surpassed 1,000, with approximately 4,500 people missing. Hundreds of unidentified victims have reportedly been buried as morgues were overwhelmed. Rescue efforts continue, but hopes are fading for those trapped in mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区灾难性的洪水造成的死亡人数已超过1000人，约有4500人失踪。据报道，由于太平间不堪重负，数百名身份不明的遇难者已被埋葬。救援工作仍在继续，但被困在水电站泥泞隧道中的失踪人员获救的希望渺茫。

body.en: ‘Technology cannot move fast enough to prevent loss’, official says, as rescue efforts for the 4,500 still missing continue Nepal last week turned down foreign ​involvement in general search and rescue but said it needed specialised services and advanced technological support in areas such as life-detecting machines, large refrigerators and pre-fabricated bridges. Aid worth more than $42m has poured into the country and Nepal is now working with experts from other countries to help with rescue operations. Continue reading...
body.zh: 官员称，截至周二上午，尼泊尔和中国发生的特大洪水造成的死亡人数已超过 1,000 人，据报道，洪水淹没了太平间，当局正在埋葬数百名身份不明的遇难者。 尼泊尔救灾机构在周二发布的最新消息中称，该国已统计出 987 人死亡、3,916 人失踪，其中包括 583 名外国人。 中国当局在周日发布的最新消息中称，已有 16 人死亡、546 人失踪。 灾难发生后的最初 72 小时被视为对救援行动至关重要，而找到失踪人员生还的希望也越来越渺茫。 尽管如此，救援工作仍在继续，但由于地形复杂、洪水持续高涨和恶劣的天气而变得复杂。 上周三发生了毁灭性的洪水，当时喜马拉雅山的一大片冰川松动，坠落到尼泊尔朗唐国家公园的谷底，释放出一道巨大的水墙和泥浆，冲入河流和山谷。 由此引发的洪水摧毁了村庄并摧毁了发电站、道路和桥梁等重要基础设施。 目前，救援工作主要集中在寻找大约 900 名失踪的水电工人，其中数百人可能被困在尼泊尔 12 个水电项目的隧道和地下区域中。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特周一对路透社表示：“大量碎片已经堆积起来，这给我们打开隧道带来了巨大挑战。” 正如我的同事在这篇报道中指出的那样，上特里苏里水电站项目周末约有 250 人获救，陆军工程师开始在现场进行爆破作业，营救另外 42 名被认为失踪的工人。 担心许多人仍然被困在流经尼泊尔中部的特里苏里河沿岸水电站的庞大泥浆隧道网络中。

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have brought immense loss, with over a thousand lives tragically ended and thousands more missing. In the face of such profound grief and destruction, we look to the promise of a future where suffering and death will be no more. May Yahweh comfort those who mourn and grant them His peace.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区毁灭性的洪水带来了巨大的损失，超过一千条生命不幸终结，另有数千人失踪。面对如此深切的悲痛和毁灭，我们寄望于一个不再有痛苦和死亡的未来。愿雅伟安慰那些哀恸的人，并赐予他们平安。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: As glaciers melt, can communities be protected?
title.zh: 冰川融化，社区能否得到保护？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 气温上升增加了山区洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案，以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士巴滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，当时几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪爆发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员 Levan Tielidze 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩石斜坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯联邦北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪崩塌和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽告诉德国之声：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（36 华氏度），与 2020 年的水平相比，更广泛的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖面积可能会减少多达一半……

reflection.en: The news from Nepal and Tibet paints a stark picture of creation groaning under the weight of climate change. Glaciers, formed over millennia, are becoming unstable, leading to devastating 'mountain tsunamis.' This echoes Romans 8:22, which speaks of all creation groaning in the pains of childbirth, awaiting its redemption from decay. The urgent need for...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔和西藏的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的景象：在气候变化的重压下，受造界发出痛苦的呻吟。历经千年形成的冰川正变得不稳定，导致毁灭性的“山洪海啸”。这呼应了罗马书8:22所说，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦直到如今，等待着从败坏中得释放。对解决方案的迫切需求，凸显了我们共同的责任，要关爱这个脆弱的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Albanese responds after China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan at Pacific summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋岛国论坛将带来“后果”

summary.en: China's top diplomat for Pacific Island Countries, Qian Bo, has warned of 'consequences' regarding Taiwan's presence as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau. He expressed China's 'serious concerns' and called Taiwan's participation 'inappropriate,' though he denied...
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波警告，台湾作为太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议的发展伙伴出席将带来“后果”。他表达了中国“严重关切”，并称台湾的参与“不恰当”，但他否认其言论是威胁。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has stopped short of criticising China over threats of "consequences" for Taiwan's attendance at an annual Pacific summit, saying the forum decides who takes part.

Albanese's comments follow a warning from China's top Pacific Islands diplomat, who said "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, with the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Albanese said he was "not distracted" when asked if Taiwan's presence was a distraction. Asked if he thought it was appropriate for China to make threats, the prime minister said: "The Pacific Islands Forum determines what happens here, not any other country."

Earlier, China's special envoy for Pacific Island affairs, Qian Bo, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" about Taiwan's status as a development partner at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the forum's opening ceremony on Monday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. Beijing views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary .

Like the United States, Australia recognises and has formal ties with China, but maintains unofficial ties with Taiwan.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is being represented this year by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, China placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taiwan.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

Qian also claimed China has the "understanding and...
body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: As leaders gather in Palau for the Pacific Islands Forum, diplomatic tensions simmer. China's envoy has voiced strong objections to Taiwan's participation, warning of 'consequences.' In such moments of heightened political friction, the call to pursue peace and seek diplomatic solutions, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 在太平洋岛国论坛领导人在帕劳举行会议之际，外交紧张局势悄然升温。中国特使对台湾的参与表达了强烈反对，并警告将有“后果”。在政治摩擦加剧的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与外交解决方案的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: 'Hoping for a miracle': Family of missing Australian in Nepal speaks
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾死亡人数超950人，救援人员争分夺秒营救被困隧道工人

summary.en: Rescuers are urgently working to free hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were inundated by mud from catastrophic flooding along the Nepal-China border. The combined death toll in Nepal and China has surpassed 950, with over 4400 people missing. At least 900 workers are unaccounted for at...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-中国边境发生灾难性洪水后，救援人员正争分夺秒地营救被埋在水电站隧道中的数百名工人。尼泊尔和中国的合计死亡人数已超过950人，另有超过4400人失踪。受洪水影响的12个水电项目至少有900名工人下落不明。

body.en:
The Australian government has confirmed two Australians have been safely located amid catastrophic flooding on the Nepal-China border as the number of people killed climbs and increasingly desperate families search for missing loved ones.

The combined deaths in Nepal and China surpassed 1,000, with more than 4,400 people — including 42 Australians — missing.

In a statement, his family said he had been visiting Mount Kailash on a pilgrimage trek when the floods hit. He went missing shortly after making contact at the Gyirong Port border crossing.

"Luke is an extremely strong, compassionate, disciplined and spiritual person," the statement said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Once he makes a decision, he commits to it fully and he was so excited to be visiting Mount Kailash.

"We can do nothing but continue hoping for a miracle that Luke, and the others who remain missing, are found alive and well."

Officials were in contact on Tuesday with an Australian in Tibet, after another Australian, Cara Severino, was located safely on the weekend.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said she was "incredibly thankful" a second Australian has been found, whose identity the government did not confirm.

"It’s hard to imagine the sense of relief their loved ones must be feeling after what will have been an incredibly harrowing few days," Wong said in a statement.

"Despite this second piece of welcome news in recent days, we must remain realistic about the days ahead .... the conditions facing search and recovery teams are extremely challenging."

Nepal's disaster agency said 987 deaths had been counted there, while Chinese authorities reported 16 deaths in their most recent update on Sunday.

Rescuers are racing to free hundreds of workers believed to be trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were buried in mud by the flooding.

A private-sector association representing power companies said at least 900 workers were unaccounted for at 12 hydropower projects damaged by the flash floods in Nepal's Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts.

At least one expert said that some workers could have access to oxygen, but others warned that the chances of finding survivors were diminishing.

As the rescue efforts intensified, four bodies were recovered from three mud-filled tunnels, Nepal's army said.

Some workers managed to call for help when the disaster struck last Wednesday, and others who managed to flee reported to authorities and relatives that many of their colleagues were still in the tunnels, said Mohan Kumar Dangi, president of the Independent Power Producers' Association.

It was unclear whether rescuers have had any contact with the trapped...
body.zh: 随着死亡人数不断攀升，以及越来越绝望的家庭寻找失踪亲人，救援人员正在竞相营救数百名据信被困在水电站隧道中的工人，这些工人因尼泊尔和中国边境的灾难性洪水而被埋在泥土中。 尼泊尔和中国的死亡人数合计超过 950 人，超过 4400 人失踪，其中包括 43 名澳大利亚人。 代表电力公司的私营部门协会表示，尼泊尔拉苏瓦和努瓦科特地区因山洪爆发而受损的 12 个水电项目中，至少有 900 名工人下落不明。 至少一位专家表示，一些工人可以获得氧气，但其他专家警告说，找到幸存者的机会正在减少。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尼泊尔军方表示，随着救援工作的加强，从三个充满泥浆的隧道中找到了四具尸体。 独立电力生产商协会主席莫汉·库马尔·丹吉(Mohan Kumar Dangi)表示，上周三灾难发生时，一些工人设法寻求帮助，其他设法逃离的工人向当局和亲属报告，他们的许多同事仍在隧道里。 目前还不清楚自最初发出求救信号以来，救援人员是否与被困工人有过任何接触。 丹吉说，灾难发生六天后，人们越来越担心有些人可能会窒息而死。 救援工作的重点是被困在为控制水流而建造的巨大隧道中的人们。 “这些隧道足够大，可以让卡车通过，”位于孟加拉国达卡的奥地利格拉茨大学的地球科学家雅各布·施泰纳说。 “据我们了解，他们已经设法为一些被困在里面的人提供氧气，并正在努力营救他们。不过，这是一场时间竞赛，因为人们需要食物和水。” Dangi 说，在受灾最严重的 Rasuwa 地区的 Upper Trishuli-1 水电站项目中，至少有 576 人失踪，并补充说，其中约 300 人据信被困在该项目的隧道内。 尼泊尔陆军发言人 Raja Ram Basnet 准将表示，在 Trishuli-3 水电项目中，工作人员正在努力下潜到隧道内约 15 米处，以营救被困在隧道内的人员。 尼泊尔达丁一座遭受洪水破坏的发电站的工人们正在铲泥，他们表示，该发电站是为该地区 2 万多人提供电力的关键线路。 中方的救援和恢复工作包括重建通往吉隆口岸的道路，该口岸负责控制中尼之间的交通。 当工人们试图重新铺设道路时，卡车运载着巨大的岩石。

reflection.en: The news from the Nepal-China border is grim, with hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels following catastrophic floods. In such moments, the cry of the vulnerable echoes, reminding us of the biblical call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. May we be moved to advocate for the safety and rescue of these individuals, reflecting the compassion...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-中国边境传来的消息令人心痛，数百名工人在灾难性的洪水后被困于隧道之中。在这样的时刻，弱者的呼喊回响，提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为那些无法为自己发声的人说话。愿我们被触动，为这些人的安全和救援而倡导，体现《箴言》31:8-9所敦促我们的怜悯之心。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水图像

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后出现了数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则用官方内容充斥了各大平台。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story describes how visual evidence of a devastating flood in Tibet was systematically erased, replaced by official narratives. This act of censorship raises questions about truth and transparency, reminding us of the importance of speaking truthfully and avoiding deception, as Ephesians 4:25 urges.
reflection.zh: 故事描述了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据如何被系统性地抹去，并被官方叙事所取代。这种审查行为引发了关于真相和透明度的疑问，提醒我们说实话和避免欺骗的重要性，正如以弗所书4:25所敦促的那样。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Nepal flood relief vehicles trapped as heavy rain turns roads to mud
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾救援车辆因暴雨泥泞受阻

summary.zh: 连日暴雨严重阻碍了尼泊尔的救援工作，此前该国与西藏边境地区发生了山洪灾害，导致数千人失踪。

reflection.en: In Nepal, the vital work of delivering aid is stalled by relentless rain, turning roads into impassable mud. This situation underscores the urgent need for practical compassion, as described in Isaiah 58:7, which calls us to share our food with the hungry and provide shelter for the displaced. Even when physical barriers arise, the spirit of helping those...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔，倾盆大雨将道路变成泥泞，阻碍了至关重要的救援物资运送。这一困境凸显了《以赛亚书》58章7节所呼吁的切实怜悯：要将食物分给饥饿的人，将无家可归的人接到家中。即使面临实际的障碍，帮助那些急需援助之人的心意，仍是信仰的深刻体现。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

The case raises difficult questions about young people and risky sex, consent, and the responsibility of...

body.en: The death of a 16-year-old in Sydney’s northern beaches from a suspected act of sexual strangulation has put a spotlight on the dangerous trend – a trend that more than half of people under 40 say they’ve tried. The case raises difficult questions about young people and risky sex, consent, and the responsibility of the porn industry. Today, Matilda Boseley speaks to global editor Lucy Clark and lifestyle editor Alyx Gorman about why so many people wrongly believe sexual choking is ‘safe’, and the education and regulation that can combat it Read more: Choking is sold to teens as a safe sexual practice. The research says it never is Police investigate death of teenage girl two days after alleged ‘sexual choking’ act in Sydney A 16-year-old girl has died from suspected sexual choking. How do we come to terms with this? | Lucy Clark Continue reading...
body.zh: 悉尼北部海滩一名 16 岁青少年涉嫌性勒颈死亡事件，让这一危险趋势成为人们关注的焦点——超过一半的 40 岁以下的人表示他们曾尝试过这种趋势。此案提出了有关年轻人、危险性行为、同意以及色情行业责任的难题。今天，玛蒂尔达·博斯利 (Matilda Boseley) 向全球编辑露西·克拉克 (Lucy Clark) 和生活方式编辑艾莉克斯·戈尔曼 (Alyx Gorman) 讲述了为什么这么多人错误地认为性窒息是“安全的”，以及可以与之对抗的教育和监管。阅读更多：窒息被作为一种安全的性行为卖给青少年。研究称，悉尼警方从未对一名少女在涉嫌“性窒息”行为两天后的死亡事件进行调查。一名 16 岁女孩因疑似性窒息而死亡。我们如何接受这一点？ |露西·克拉克继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic death of a 16-year-old in Sydney brings into sharp focus the vulnerability of youth to dangerous trends, often fueled by misinformation. This situation calls for a renewed commitment to protecting the defenseless and ensuring they have the knowledge and support to make safe choices.
reflection.zh: 一名16岁少女在悉尼的悲惨死亡，使年轻人容易受到危险趋势影响的脆弱性成为焦点，而这些趋势常常是由错误信息助长的。这种情况呼吁我们重申保护弱者的承诺，并确保他们拥有做出安全选择的知识和支持。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

However, the author argues that the GDP figures do not strongly suggest an economy in need of slowing down, implying that a closer...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚经济在六月份季度增长了0.4%，一些经济学家认为这是经济过热的迹象，需要进一步加息。然而，作者认为国内生产总值（GDP）数据并未强烈表明经济需要放缓，这意味着在实施另一次加息之前，需要仔细审查数据和专家意见。

body.en: The story of the economy at the moment is one of give and take – and what’s good for investment is bad for trade Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the Bureau of Statistics released the GDP figures on Wednesday , the June quarter 0.4% growth figure immediately drew headlines of a rate rise to come, but there is little within the GDP figures that suggests an economy needing slowing. In the end it grew 0.4% and brought out the suggestions that the growth was “above expectations” and thus in some way hot and in need of cooling off by another interest rate rise. Continue reading...
body.zh: 目前的经济形势是一种让步——对投资有利的事情对贸易不利 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当统计局周三发布 GDP 数据时，6 月份季度 0.4% 的增长数据立即成为了即将加息的头条新闻，但 GDP 数据中几乎没有任何迹象表明经济需要放缓。在此之前，银行经济学家和投掷飞镖的人的平均预期是6月份经济将增长0.3%。最终增长了0.4%，并暗示增长“超出预期”，因此在某种程度上过热，需要通过再次加息来降温。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Economic policy decisions, especially those impacting everyday citizens like interest rate adjustments, require careful deliberation. The principle of seeking wise counsel, as highlighted in Proverbs, is crucial for leaders navigating complex financial landscapes. It reminds us that informed decisions, based on thorough analysis and expert advice, are vital...
reflection.zh: 经济政策的制定，尤其是那些影响普通民众的决策（如调整利率），需要深思熟虑。《箴言》中强调的寻求明智建议的原则，对于在复杂金融环境中导航的领导者至关重要。它提醒我们，基于透彻分析和专家意见的明智决策，对于社区的福祉至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

Charges...

Eyad Shadid has launched a civil case in the NSW district court, alleging he was assaulted, battered and falsely imprisoned by police near Sydney’s town hall. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：埃亚德·沙迪德 (Eyad Shadid) 在对他的指控被撤销后，向地区法院提起民事诉讼，声称他二月份在悉尼市政厅附近被“殴打” 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 一名巴勒斯坦澳大利亚男子声称，他在试图阻止警察骚扰在反艾萨克·赫尔佐格抗议活动中祈祷的穆斯林男子时，脸部被打了一拳，他正在起诉新南威尔士州“一系列虚假指控”。埃亚德·沙迪德（Eyad Shadid）向新南威尔士州地区法院提起民事诉讼，指控他在悉尼市政厅附近遭到警察的袭击、殴打和错误监禁。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of justice is a profound human and spiritual need. When individuals feel wronged, especially by those in authority, the path to accountability and healing often involves seeking legal recourse, as Mr. Shadid has done. May this case bring clarity and a just resolution, reflecting the ancient call for justice to 'roll on like a river, a...
reflection.zh: 追求正义是深刻的人类和属灵需求。当个人感到受到不公对待，尤其是来自当权者时，追究责任和疗愈的道路往往涉及寻求法律途径，正如 Shadid 先生所做的那样。愿此案带来清晰和公正的裁决，体现古老的呼唤：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。”

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: I was once ashamed to admit I’d been strangled nonconsensually during sex. Now I’m speaking up to save women’s lives | Hannah Ferguson
title.zh: 我曾羞于承认在性行为中被非自愿勒死。现在我站出来是为了拯救女性的生命 | 汉娜·弗格森

summary.en: The article discusses the alarming trend of young men being taught that potentially lethal acts are erotic, citing the recent death of a 16-year-old girl in Sydney's northern beaches, whose death is being investigated as sexual strangulation. The author urges the government to regulate big tech and criminalize...
summary.zh: 文章讨论了年轻男性被教导将可能致命的行为视为色情的令人担忧的趋势，并引用了最近悉尼北部海滩一名16岁女孩的死亡事件，她的死亡正被调查为性窒息。作者敦促政府监管大型科技公司并取缔描绘窒息的色情内容。

body.en: Young men are being taught that acts with the potential to kill are erotic. The Albanese government must urgently regulate big tech and criminalise pornography depicting strangulation Last week, a 16-year-old girl was found unresponsive in a home on Sydney’s northern beaches. She was airlifted to hospital and died two days later. New South Wales police are investigating her death as the result of a sexual strangulation act. Sources told the ABC the deceased may have experienced a seizure following asphyxiation, and that officers were told the sex was consensual. While that investigation has yet to run its course, speaking generally, strangulation during sex is not a new phenomenon or conversation. Just a few years ago it was relatively taboo to criticise this normalisation of violence in sex – it was often framed as “anti-kink” to raise concern about this dangerous act that is increasingly depicted in mainstream pornography. Continue reading...
body.zh: 年轻人被教导说，有可能杀人的行为都是色情行为。阿尔巴尼亚政府必须紧急监管大型科技，并将描绘勒死的色情内容定为犯罪。上周，一名 16 岁女孩被发现在悉尼北部海滩的一所房子里失去了知觉。她被空运到医院，两天后死亡。新南威尔士州警方正在调查她因性勒颈而死亡的情况。消息人士告诉美国广播公司，死者可能在窒息后经历了癫痫发作，警方被告知性行为是双方同意的。虽然这项调查尚未结束，但总的来说，性行为中的勒颈并不是一个新现象或新话题。就在几年前，批评这种性暴力的正常化还是相对禁忌的——它经常被描述为“反性癖”，以引起人们对这种在主流色情作品中越来越多地描绘的危险行为的担忧。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic death of a 16-year-old girl, investigated as sexual strangulation, underscores a profound vulnerability. In a world where dangerous acts can be normalized or even eroticized, we are called to defend the defenseless. This moment demands our attention and action to protect those most at risk.
reflection.zh: 一名16岁女孩的悲惨死亡，被调查为性窒息，凸显了一种深刻的脆弱性。在一个危险行为可能被常态化甚至色情化的世界里，我们被呼召去保护弱者。这一刻要求我们关注并采取行动，以保护那些最处于危险中的人。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.zh: 我们购买电动汽车而不是去欧洲度假——以及我们从澳大利亚国民账户中学到的其他东西

We are called to remember Yahweh, who gives us the power to gain wealth, and to use these resources wisely and gratefully.
reflection.zh: 即使在全球充满挑战的时期，国家也能实现经济增长。这提醒我们，繁荣并非仅仅是人类努力或有利条件的结果，而是一份恩赐。我们被呼召要记念雅伟，祂赐予我们获取财富的能力，并要明智而感恩地使用这些资源。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

reflection.en: The leaders of Pacific island nations are navigating complex geopolitical currents, yet their urgent pleas to Australia highlight their immediate concerns: climate change and the drug trade. These are matters of justice and well-being for their people, echoing the prophet Micah's call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Their focus on...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正驾驭复杂的地缘政治暗流，但他们向澳大利亚发出的紧急呼吁，凸显了他们眼前的关切：气候变化和毒品交易。这些关乎其人民的福祉和公义，呼应了先知弥迦的呼召，要行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。他们关注切实的需要而非遥远的冲突，提醒我们真正的优先事项往往在哪里。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'Didn’t think twice': The routine activity that sent Robert to the emergency department
title.zh: “没多想”：罗伯特因此被送往急诊室的日常活动

summary.en: For millions of Australians, gardening is a weekend ritual, but experts warn there can be more than nutrients and organic matter in a bag of potting mix. Bacteria and fungi are a natural part of the material, and while most pose no threat to healthy people, some can cause serious infections in those who are more...
summary.zh: 对数百万澳大利亚人来说，园艺是一种周末的例行活动，但专家警告说，一袋盆栽土中可能含有比养分和有机物更多的东西。细菌和真菌是该物质的天然组成部分，虽然大多数对健康人没有威胁，但有些可能导致易感人群感染严重疾病。其中最著名的例子之一是长白氏军团菌，这是一种与盆栽土和土壤有关的细菌，可引起军团病。对于72岁的悉尼园丁罗伯特来...

body.en:
For millions of Australians, gardening is a weekend ritual, but experts warn there can be more than nutrients and organic matter in a bag of potting mix.

Bacteria and fungi are a natural part of the material, and while most pose no threat to healthy people, some can cause serious infections in those who are more susceptible.

One of the best-known examples is Legionella longbeachae, a species of bacteria associated with potting mix and soil that can cause Legionnaires' disease.

For 72-year-old Sydney gardener Robert, that risk became a reality after routinely handling potting mix without taking the precautions recommended on the packaging.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

He told SBS News that he ended up in hospital after developing Pontiac fever, a milder form of illness caused by exposure to Legionella bacteria.

Unlike Legionnaires' disease, Pontiac fever does not cause pneumonia and usually resolves on its own.

But Robert's experience was a reminder that something as ordinary as opening a bag of potting mix can expose people to bacteria capable of causing illness.

While he recovered after a trip to the emergency department, he says the experience has changed how he approaches gardening.

"I never really thought twice about handling potting mix. You just open the bag and get stuck into it," he said.

"After getting sick from it, I'll definitely be wearing a mask and gloves because it's just not worth taking the risk of getting something worse next time."

His case also highlights the spectrum of illness associated with Legionella, from a relatively mild, self-limiting infection to potentially fatal pneumonia.

Richard Bentham, adjunct associate professor at Flinders University, says potting mix is effectively a living ecosystem.

"Potting mix is made by microorganisms, so it's very, very rich in microorganisms," he says.

He told SBS News that some microbes can cause infection when they encounter someone who is particularly susceptible.

Legionella longbeachae is one example, but Bentham says other bacteria, including mycobacteria, can also be found in potting mix and potentially cause infection.

But he insists that the presence of microorganisms does not mean potting mix is inherently dangerous.

Bentham said millions of bags are used safely every year and that the risk of serious infection remains low, but the consequences can be severe for people who are more vulnerable.

Experts say the main concern is what happens when contaminated material is disturbed, and fine particles can become airborne when dry potting mix is opened or handled, allowing microorganisms to be inhaled.

Bentham said inhalation is considered an important route of...
body.zh: 对于数百万澳大利亚人来说，园艺是一种周末仪式，但专家警告说，一袋盆栽混合物中含有的不仅仅是营养物质和有机物质。 细菌和真菌是材料的天然组成部分，虽然大多数不会对健康人构成威胁，但有些细菌和真菌可能会对易感人群造成严重感染。 最著名的例子之一是长滩军团菌，这是一种与盆栽混合物和土壤相关的细菌，可引起军团病。 对于 72 岁的悉尼园丁罗伯特来说，由于经常处理盆栽混合物而没有采取包装上建议的预防措施，这种风险成为了现实。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他告诉 SBS 新闻，他因患上庞蒂亚克热而入院，庞蒂亚克热是一种因接触军团菌而引起的较轻的疾病。 与军团病不同，庞蒂亚克热不会引起肺炎，通常会自行消退。 但罗伯特的经历提醒人们，像打开一袋盆栽混合物这样平常的事情就会使人们接触到能够引起疾病的细菌。 虽然他在去急诊室后康复了，但他说这次经历改变了他从事园艺的方式。 “在处理盆栽混合物时，我从来没有真正考虑过。你只需打开袋子，然后就卡在里面，”他说。 “生病后，我肯定会戴上口罩和手套，因为不值得冒下次病情恶化的风险。” 他的病例还凸显了与军团菌相关的一系列疾病，从相对轻微的自限性感染到可能致命的肺炎。 弗林德斯大学兼职副教授理查德·本瑟姆 (Richard Bentham) 表示，盆栽混合物实际上是一个活生生的生态系统。 “盆栽混合物是由微生物制成的，因此微生物含量非常非常丰富，”他说。 他告诉SBS新闻，一些微生物在遇到特别易感的人时会引起感染。 长滩军团菌就是一个例子，但边沁说，其他细菌，包括分枝杆菌，也可以在盆栽混合物中发现，并可能引起感染。 但他坚持认为微生物的存在并不意味着盆栽混合物本质上是危险的。 边沁表示，每年有数百万个袋子得到安全使用，严重感染的风险仍然很低，但对于弱势群体来说，后果可能会很严重。 专家表示，主要担心的是当受污染的材料受到干扰时会发生什么，当打开或处理干燥的盆栽混合物时，细小颗粒可能会进入空气中，从而使微生物被吸入。 边沁说，吸入被认为是...的一个重要途径。

reflection.en: Gardening, a common and often therapeutic pastime, can unexpectedly lead to serious illness for those with compromised health. This story reminds us of the vulnerability of the human body and the importance of heeding warnings, even for seemingly benign activities. It calls us to pray for the sick, especially those whose health is fragile, and to be mindful...
reflection.zh: 园艺是一项普遍且常具疗愈作用的爱好，但对于健康状况不佳的人来说，它可能意外地导致严重疾病。这个故事提醒我们人体的脆弱性，以及即使对于看似无害的活动，遵从警告的重要性。它呼吁我们为病人祈祷，特别是那些健康状况脆弱的人，并注意那些能保护我们和他人的预防措施。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: The possible cost of Australia's stronger-than-expected growth
title.zh: 澳大利亚经济增长超出预期可能付出的代价

summary.en: Australia's stronger GDP figures could complicate the Reserve Bank's next interest rate decision.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚强于预期的GDP数据可能会使储备银行的下一次利率决定复杂化。

body.en:
Australia's economy is "resilient and robust", Treasurer Jim Chalmers says, after fresh data showed stronger growth, though the figures may also add to pressure on the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to raise interest rates again.

Australia's gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 2.1 per cent — a sign of increased economic activity — in the last financial year, the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) reported on Wednesday.

A growing GDP suggests more business activity and can lead to more jobs being created as demand for goods and services rises.

"Growth is as strong, if not stronger, than every major advanced economy," he said in a video posted to social media.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But increases in spending can also mean demand for goods outpaces supply, leading to price increases and contributing to inflation.

The hot GDP result could therefore add more pressure on the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to raise interest rates again as it struggles to close the gap between supply and demand.

Australia's cash rate target is currently 4.35 per cent following three rate hikes this year.

Despite the impact of higher interest rates and the United States-Iran war, GDP growth accelerated on a quarterly basis from 0.3 per cent in March.

While the 2.1 per cent annual growth rate is faster than the RBA's assumed speed limit of 2 per cent, it was a subdued result by historical standards, as households continued to behave cautiously, ABS head of national accounts Grace Kim said.

"While increased spending and business investment occurred in pockets of the economy, imports supported much of the growth, moderating its contribution to overall GDP growth," she said.

Imports of goods rose 2.4 per cent, driven by increased purchases of cars and planes.

Meanwhile, services imports fell 4.9 per cent as Australians' travel plans were disrupted by war in the Middle East.

"The number of Australians travelling overseas for the northern hemisphere summer fell for the first time since the COVID-19 pandemic, significantly reducing international travel expenditure," Kim said.

Household consumption rose 0.4 per cent, with falls in fuel consumption and travel due to higher fuel prices.

But the oil crisis also supported growth as consumers flocked to electric vehicles . EV purchases rose 10.3 per cent.

"The rise in electric vehicle purchases may have reflected households taking a longer-term approach to cost-of-living pressures, with some choosing EVs to help reduce ongoing expenses," Kim said.

Meanwhile, private business investment declined 0.5 per cent, due to a pullback in data centre investment.

body.zh: 财长吉姆·查默斯表示，在新数据显示经济增长强劲后，澳大利亚经济“富有弹性且强劲”，不过这些数据也可能增加澳大利亚储备银行（RBA）再次加息的压力。 澳大利亚统计局 (ABS) 周三报告称，上一财年澳大利亚国内生产总值 (GDP) 增长了 2.1%，这是经济活动增加的迹象。 GDP 的增长意味着商业活动的增加，并且随着商品和服务需求的增加，可以创造更多的就业机会。 他在社交媒体上发布的一段视频中表示：“增长即使不是比每个主要发达经济体都强劲，也同样强劲。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但支出增加也可能意味着商品需求超过供应，导致价格上涨并加剧通货膨胀。 因此，热门的GDP结果可能会给澳大利亚储备银行（RBA）带来更大的压力，使其再次加息，因为它正在努力缩小供需之间的差距。 在今年三次加息后，澳大利亚的现金利率目标目前为 4.35%。 尽管受到利率上升和美伊战争的影响，GDP环比增速仍从3月份的0.3%开始加速。 ABS国民账户主管格蕾丝·金(Grace Kim)表示，虽然2.1%的年增长率高于澳大利亚央行假设的2%的速度限制，但以历史标准来看，这是一个较低的结果，因为家庭继续谨慎行事。 她表示：“虽然经济的某些领域支出和商业投资有所增加，但进口支撑了大部分增长，从而削弱了其对 GDP 总体增长的贡献。” 由于汽车和飞机购买量增加，商品进口增长 2.4%。 与此同时，由于澳大利亚人的旅行计划因中东战争而中断，服务进口下降了4.9%。 Kim 表示：“北半球夏季出国旅游的澳大利亚人数量自 COVID-19 大流行以来首次下降，国际旅行支出大幅减少。” 家庭消费增长了 0.4%，由于燃油价格上涨，燃料消耗和旅行减少。 但随着消费者纷纷转向电动汽车，石油危机也支撑了经济增长。电动汽车购买量增长 10.3%。 金说：“电动汽车购买量的增加可能反映了家庭采取长期方法来应对生活成本压力，其中一些人选择电动汽车来帮助减少持续开支。” 与此同时，由于数据中心投资减少，私营企业投资下降了 0.5%。 人均GDP与上年同期持平...

reflection.en: Australia's economy is showing robust growth, a sign of increased activity and potential job creation. While this economic strength is a positive indicator, it also presents challenges, such as potentially influencing interest rate decisions. It reminds us that prosperity is a gift, and its management requires wisdom and careful consideration of its broader...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚经济显示出强劲的增长，这是活动增加和潜在就业机会的迹象。虽然这种经济实力是一个积极的指标，但它也带来了挑战，例如可能影响利率决定。这提醒我们，繁荣是一种恩赐，其管理需要智慧和对更广泛影响的仔细考虑。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Revealed: The failures behind Telstra's major network outage
title.zh: 揭秘：导致澳大利亚电信公司重大网络中断的失败之处

summary.en: An independent investigation found that Telstra failed to prioritize critical systems and lacked the technical expertise to maintain them, leading to a major nationwide network outage on July 8th. This failure disrupted essential services like Triple Zero calls, businesses, train networks, and electronic payments,...
summary.zh: 一项独立调查发现，澳大利亚电信公司（Telstra）未能优先处理关键系统，并且缺乏维护这些系统的技术专长，导致7月8日发生了全国性的重大网络中断。此次故障扰乱了包括零号紧急呼叫、商业活动、火车网络和电子支付服务在内的关键服务，并引发了监管审查。

body.en:
Telstra did not prioritise systems that caused a major nationwide network failure and lacked the technical expertise to properly maintain them, an independent investigation has found.

The results of the review into the telco's 8 July network failure, which left thousands of Australians unable to make calls or access data, were released on Tuesday.

The outage sparked chaos with Triple Zero calls and businesses affected, along with failures across train networks and electronic payment services.

A lack of ownership and oversight of the functions that led to the outage were identified as key contributing factors by Technology Audit Partners in the report.

The outage began at 2.50am, nearly an hour earlier than identified by Telstra at the time.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Following the outage, Telstra confirmed it had conducted welfare checks on those who tried to place more than 600 unsuccessful emergency calls.

The investigation also found a further eight Triple Zero calls did not go through to emergency services during the outage. Welfare checks were conducted in relation to those unsuccessful calls, with no adverse outcomes identified, according to the company.

The outage was triggered by a software update not being done on a GPS card, which resulted in incorrect date information.

It was primarily a result of Telstra not treating network timing as a critical capability, the report found.

On the night of the outage, the two primary engineers involved in the botched upgrade were on mandatory stand-down, the report found.

"The overarching finding is we did not prioritise our timing system inside our networks at the highest level as a critical capability, which is exactly what it should have been," chief executive Vicki Brady told media on Wednesday.

Brady said additional resources and expertise had been allocated to the impacted area.

Since the outage, just over 30,000 customers have contacted the telco, which has processed credits of just under $1 million for those customers.

Any customers who felt they were impacted and had not been in contact were encouraged to reach out to the company.

Brady was among 10 senior executives whose bonus was cut as a result of the outage. Her total compensation was $6.8 million, 11 per cent more than the previous year.

A separate ongoing Australian Communications and Media Authority investigation into the outage could result in fines of up to $30 million.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 一项独立调查发现，澳洲电信没有优先考虑导致全国范围内重大网络故障的系统，并且缺乏正确维护这些系统的技术专业知识。 周二公布了对该电信公司 7 月 8 日网络故障的审查结果，该故障导致数千名澳大利亚人无法拨打电话或访问数据。 这次停电引发了混乱，“三零”电话和企业受到影响，火车网络和电子支付服务也出现故障。 技术审计合作伙伴在报告中将缺乏所有权和对职能的监督视为导致服务中断的关键因素。 停电于凌晨 2.50 开始，比 Telstra 当时确定的时间早了近一个小时。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 停电后，澳洲电信证实，它已对那些试图拨打 600 多个紧急电话但未成功的人进行了福利检查。 调查还发现，在停电期间，另外 8 个“三零”电话没有转接到紧急服务部门。该公司表示，对那些不成功的电话进行了福利检查，没有发现任何不良后果。 此次中断是由于未在 GPS 卡上进行软件更新而引发的，从而导致日期信息不正确。 报告发现，这主要是由于 Telstra 没有将网络计时视为一项关键功能。 报告发现，在停电当晚，参与升级失败的两名主要工程师被强制停工。 首席执行官维琪·布雷迪 (Vicki Brady) 周三对媒体表示：“最重要的发现是，我们没有将网络内部的计时系统作为一项关键能力放在最高级别，而这正是它应该做的。” 布雷迪表示，已向受影响地区分配了额外的资源和专业知识。 自停电以来，已有超过 30,000 名客户联系了该电信公司，该公司已为这些客户处理了近 100 万美元的信用额度。 我们鼓励任何认为自己受到影响且没有联系过的客户与该公司联系。 布雷迪是因停电而削减奖金的 10 名高级管理人员之一。她的总薪酬为 680 万澳元，比上一年增加了 11%。 澳大利亚通信和媒体管理局正在对此次中断进行单独调查，可能会导致高达 3000 万澳元的罚款。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The investigation into Telstra's network failure points to a breakdown in responsibility and oversight. It's a stark reminder that neglecting essential systems, whether in technology or in our communities, can have far-reaching consequences. True accountability involves not just identifying failures, but actively working to ensure such lapses do not recur,...
reflection.zh: 对澳大利亚电信公司网络故障的调查指出了责任和监督方面的失误。这有力地提醒我们，无论是在技术领域还是在我们的社区中，忽视关键系统都可能产生深远的影响。真正的问责不仅在于查明失败之处，更在于积极努力确保此类疏漏不再发生，这体现了雅伟呼吁我们秉持公义、寻求问责的精神。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The 'harmful' online rabbit hole finding teens within minutes
title.zh: 被推入“男人圈”：社交媒体算法在不到25分钟内针对十几岁的男孩

summary.en: Teach Us Consent founder Chanel Contos urges an end to default algorithmic feeds to protect teenage boys online.
summary.zh: “教我们同意”的创始人Chanel Contos敦促结束默认的算法推送，以保护网络上的十几岁男孩。

body.en:
Social media empires are being put on notice for content that promotes controlling, violent sexual acts.

Big tech companies are radicalising young men into harmful sexual acts, the founder of education and advocacy organisation Teach Us Consent is expected to tell the National Press Club on Wednesday.

Chanel Contos will say the content is pushed by bad actors who share commercial infrastructure and have identified male psychology as a market — together, they make up the "manosphere".

"Young men online seeking community, belonging, and self-improvement advice are targeted with content that blames women for their misfortune and reinstates harmful and outdated gender roles," she is expected to say.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Contos will say that boys aged between 16 and 18 are likely to be fed misogynistic content less than 25 minutes after signing up to social media.

That was true even if preferences were set to try and exclude it, according to research from Teach Us Consent.

Teens are regularly fed content suggesting women should not leave the house alone, should not work and should not be in charge of their own money.

Most harmful content starts in the wellness landscape through gym videos or motivational content.

Contos will tell the Press Club men who subscribe to those ideals are twice as likely to binge drink and eight times as likely to have suicidal thoughts as their peers.

Australian teenage boys aged 16 to 18 are committing sexual assault against children more frequently than adults are, the Australian Child Maltreatment Study found in 2023.

Contos has previously cited media content as a driver, noting her organisation had found an explosion in peer-on-peer teen sexual violence in the past five years.

The federal government is currently exploring whether Australians should be able to opt out of algorithmically curated social media feeds, Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek told ABC Insider's program on Sunday.

The announcement came after a 16-year-old Sydney girl's death was linked in media reports to a suspected sexual choking act — a behaviour often promoted to teenage boys through pornography and social media content.

Contos will tell the Press Club that, while the change would be positive, harsher crackdowns are needed.

She will suggest feeds should only show posts from people users follow, unless users explicitly opt out, to circumvent harmful content. Such a move would revert social media algorithms to how they were a decade ago.

"(The change) would fundamentally make the transition onto social media for 16-year-olds and other children safer, and it would bring the principle of affirmative...
body.zh: 社交媒体帝国因宣扬控制性暴力性行为的内容而受到关注。 教育和倡导组织 Teach Us Consent 的创始人预计将于周三向国家新闻俱乐部表示，大型科技公司正在促使年轻男性激进地进行有害的性行为。 香奈儿·康托斯 (Chanel Contos) 表示，这些内容是由不良行为者推动的，他们共享商业基础设施，并将男性心理视为一个市场——他们共同构成了“男性圈”。 “在网上寻求社区、归属感和自我完善建议的年轻男性，会被一些内容所针对，这些内容将她们的不幸归咎于女性，并恢复有害和过时的性别角色，”她预计会说。 Contos 表示，16 至 18 岁的男孩很可能在注册社交媒体后不到 25 分钟就会收到厌恶女性的内容。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 根据 Teach Us Consent 的研究，即使偏好被设置为试图排除它，情况也是如此。 青少年经常被灌输这样的内容：建议女性不应该独自出门、不应该工作、不应该掌管自己的钱。 大多数有害内容都是从健身视频或励志内容开始的。 康托斯将告诉记者俱乐部，认同这些理想的男性酗酒的可能性是同龄人的两倍，有自杀念头的可能性是同龄人的八倍。 2023 年澳大利亚儿童虐待研究发现，澳大利亚 16 至 18 岁男孩对儿童实施性侵犯的频率高于成年人。 康托斯此前曾将媒体内容列为推动因素，并指出她的组织发现过去五年中青少年青少年性暴力激增。 社会服务部长 Tanya Plibersek 周日在 ABC Insider 节目中表示，联邦政府目前正在探索澳大利亚人是否应该能够选择退出算法策划的社交媒体信息。 媒体报道称，一名 16 岁悉尼女孩的死亡与疑似性窒息行为有关，这一行为经常通过色情内容和社交媒体内容向十几岁的男孩宣传。 孔托斯将告诉新闻俱乐部，虽然变化是积极的，但需要更严厉的打击。 她建议提要应该只显示关注者的帖子，除非用户明确选择不显示这种情况，以规避有害内容。此举将使社交媒体算法恢复到十年前的状态。 “（这一变化）将从根本上使 16 岁和其他儿童更安全地过渡到社交媒体，并且它将带来……的原则。

reflection.en: The digital world, like any space, can become a breeding ground for falsehoods and harmful ideologies. When algorithms amplify divisive and damaging content, they prey on the vulnerabilities of young minds seeking belonging. We are called to speak truth in love, countering the lies that distort reality and damage relationships.
reflection.zh: 数字世界与任何空间一样，都可能成为虚假和有害意识形态的温床。当算法放大分裂和破坏性的内容时，它们就会利用那些寻求归属感的年轻人的脆弱性。我们蒙召要以爱心说诚实话，对抗扭曲现实、破坏关系的谎言。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Hong Kong police arrest 2 from clinic over sales of bogus ‘cancer vaccine’
title.zh: 香港警方逮捕诊所两人，涉嫌销售虚假“癌症疫苗”

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have arrested a man and woman from a clinic on suspicion of selling a laboratory reagent as a bogus vaccine against more than 20 types of cancer. The arrests followed a joint operation by the Department of Health and police, during which investigators raided 13 premises linked to the company.
summary.zh: 香港当局逮捕了一名诊所的男女，他们涉嫌将一种实验室试剂谎称为可治疗20多种癌症的疫苗。此次逮捕是卫生署和警方联合行动的结果，调查人员搜查了与该公司有关的13处场所。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities have arrested a man and woman from a clinic on suspicion of selling a laboratory reagent as a bogus vaccine against more than 20 types of cancer. The arrests followed a joint operation by the Department of Health and police, during which investigators raided 13 premises linked to the company, said Frank Chan Ling-fung, an assistant director of health who oversees drug matters. Chan said there had been no reports of illness among people who had received the “WT1 cancer...
body.zh: 香港当局在一家诊所逮捕了一名男子和一名女子，他们涉嫌出售实验室试剂作为针对 20 多种癌症的假疫苗。负责监督毒品事务的卫生署助理署长陈凌峰 (Frank Chan Ling-fung) 表示，卫生署和警方联合采取行动，调查人员突击搜查了与该公司有关的 13 处场所，随后进行了逮捕。陈说，目前还没有收到“WT1 癌症患者患病的报告”。

reflection.en: The pursuit of profit led individuals to exploit the vulnerability of cancer patients, offering a false hope that preyed on their desperation. This deception stands in stark contrast to the biblical call to 'act justly,' which demands integrity and care for the vulnerable, especially those facing life-threatening illnesses.
reflection.zh: 追求利润驱使一些人利用癌症患者的脆弱性，提供虚假的希望，满足他们绝望的需求。这种欺骗与圣经中‘秉公行义’的呼召形成鲜明对比，后者要求正直和关怀弱势群体，特别是那些面临危及生命疾病的人。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Saleswoman arrested over improper sales practices
title.zh: 女售货员因不当销售行为被捕

summary.en: Customs officers arrested a 22-year-old saleswoman on suspicion of unfair trade practices. This action is part of a follow-up operation against a beauty company accused of aggressive sales tactics for skincare products and beauty devices. The saleswoman allegedly used undue influence at the company's Sha Tin branch,...
summary.zh: 海关官员周三宣布，逮捕了一名22岁的女售货员，怀疑她有不公平交易行为。这是海关部门针对一家美容公司涉嫌在销售护肤品和美容仪器时采取激进商业行为的后续行动。据称，该女子在公司沙田分店销售美容产品时施加不当影响并进行不当商业行为，导致一名顾客进行了购买。

body.en: Customs on Wednesday announced that its officers have arrested a 22-year-old female saleswoman over suspicion of unfair trade practices. This came as the department conducted a follow-up operation against a beauty company suspected of engaging in aggressive commercial practices in the sale of skincare products and beauty devices. Following the arrest of a financial manager and an administrative manager of the company, Senior Investigation Officer Leung Ka-ho said the arrestee is a frontline saleswoman. “[The woman] allegedly exerted undue influence and conducted improper commercial conduct while selling beauty products at the company’s Sha Tin branch, causing a customer to make a purchase that would not have occurred otherwise,” he said. “Therefore, customs carried out this operation. I stress that the investigation is still ongoing, and more arrests could be made.” Leung said the department has received 38 reports against the beauty company so far, involving a total of HK$3 million. Officers would continue to follow up on the reports, he said. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 海关周三宣布，其官员因涉嫌不公平贸易行为而逮捕了一名 22 岁女售货员。此前，该部门对一家涉嫌在销售护肤品和美容仪器方面采取激进商业行为的美容公司进行了后续行动。该公司一名财务经理及一名行政经理被捕后，高级调查员梁家豪表示，被捕者是一名前线销售员。 “（该女子）涉嫌在该公司沙田分店销售美容产品时施加不当影响并进行不当商业行为，导致顾客进行原本不会发生的购买，”他说。 “因此，海关进行了这次行动。我强调，调查仍在进行中，可能会逮捕更多人。”梁振英表示，海关至今已接获38宗针对该美容公司的举报，涉案金额达300万港元。他表示，警方将继续跟进报道。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The news of a saleswoman's arrest for alleged improper practices serves as a stark reminder of the importance of integrity in commerce. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly,' a principle that extends to every transaction, ensuring fairness and honesty in our dealings with others. May we all strive to conduct our work with ethical diligence, reflecting Yahweh's...
reflection.zh: 一名女售货员因涉嫌不当销售行为被捕的消息，警示我们商业诚信的重要性。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们“秉公行义”，这一原则适用于每一次交易，确保我们在与他人交往时公平诚实。愿我们都在商业活动中努力秉持道德操守，反映雅伟的品格。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Man arrested over theft of HK$5,885 in foreign currency on Bangkok to Hong Kong flight
title.zh: 男子涉嫌在曼谷飞往香港的航班上盗窃近6000港元外币被捕

summary.en: Hong Kong police arrested a 57-year-old man on suspicion of stealing approximately HK$6,000 (US$765) in foreign currency during a flight from Bangkok to Hong Kong. A fellow passenger reportedly witnessed the alleged theft, captured it on camera, and alerted the cabin crew, leading to the man's apprehension upon the...
summary.zh: 香港警方逮捕了一名57岁男子，涉嫌在从曼谷飞往香港的航班上盗窃约6000港元（765美元）的外币。据报，一名乘客目睹了此次盗窃，并用相机拍下证据，随后通知了机组人员，该男子在航班抵达香港后被捕。

body.en: Hong Kong police have arrested a man on suspicion of stealing nearly HK$6,000 (US$770) in foreign currency while flying to the city from Thailand, with a passenger allegedly capturing the incident on camera and reporting it to cabin crew. The force said the 57-year-old man was arrested for the alleged theft after the HK Express flight landed in the city shortly before midnight on Wednesday. While police estimated the currency was worth about HK$6,000, a source put the amount at 25,000 baht,...
body.zh: 香港警方逮捕了一名涉嫌在从泰国飞往香港的航班上盗窃近 6,000 港元（770 美元）外币的男子，据称一名乘客用摄像机记录了这一事件并向机组人员报告。警方表示，周三午夜前不久，香港快运航空的航班降落在香港后，这名 57 岁男子因涉嫌盗窃被捕。虽然警方估计该货币价值约 6,000 港元，但消息人士称该金额为 25,000 泰铢，...

reflection.en: The incident on the flight from Bangkok to Hong Kong serves as a stark reminder that even in transit, the principles of honesty and respect for others' property are paramount. The alleged theft of nearly HK$6,000 prompts reflection on the choices individuals make when they believe they might not be held accountable. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to...
reflection.zh: 从曼谷飞往香港的航班上发生的这起事件，令人警醒地提醒我们，即使在旅途中，诚实和尊重他人财物的原则也至关重要。涉嫌盗窃近6000港元的事件，促使我们反思当个人认为自己可能不会被追究责任时所做的选择。...

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Man, woman arrested as DH seizes unregistered jabs
title.zh: 卫生署检获未注册针剂拘捕一男一女

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have seized approximately 50 suspected unregistered injections from over 13 locations and arrested a man and a woman. The operation targeted the use of a WT1 vaccine advertised for cancer prevention, though the Assistant Director of Health stated that the seized items were mostly healthcare...
summary.zh: 香港当局在超过13个地点检获约50支疑似未注册的针剂，并拘捕了一男一女。此次行动针对一种宣传能预防多种癌症的WT1疫苗的使用，但卫生署助理署长表示，检获的物品主要是维生素等保健产品，而WT1疫苗仍在调查中。

body.en: Authorities have seized some 50 suspected unregistered injections from over 13 premises and arrested two people in a recent operation. They arrested a 28-year-old man and a woman. The operation was carried out jointly by the Department of Health and police, to crack down on the usage of the Wilms' tumor 1 (WT1) vaccine, which is advertised as being able to prevent multiple cancers. But Assistant Director of Health Frank Chan on Wednesday said authorities have so far not found any of the vaccines in the operation. “The over 50 suspected unregistered injections we found are mostly healthcare products like vitamins,” he said. “As for the WT1 vaccine, we are still carrying out an investigation. “So far, we have no report of adverse reactions to the vaccine. But we still hope to find the product in the investigation so that we can hold those responsible accountable.” Chan also said the seized injections belong to Part 1 poisons, adding relevant companies and those in charge are suspected of the illegal sale and possession of unregistered pharmaceutical products. He said the operation is still ongoing and more arrests could be made. _____________________________ Last updated: 2026-09-02 HKT 22:44 Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 当局在最近的一次行动中，从超过 13 个场所查获了约 50 支疑似未经登记的注射剂，并逮捕了两人。他们逮捕了一名 28 岁的男子和一名女子。此次行动由卫生部和警方联合开展，旨在打击使用被宣传为能够预防多种癌症的维尔姆斯肿瘤1号（WT1）疫苗。但卫生部助理总监 Frank Chan 周三表示，迄今为止，当局尚未在行动中发现任何疫苗。 “我们发现的50多个疑似未注册注射剂大多是维生素等保健品，”他说。 “至于WT1疫苗，我们还在进行调查。”到目前为止，我们还没有收到疫苗不良反应的报告。但我们还是希望能在调查中找到该产品，以便追究相关责任人的责任。”陈又表示，检获的注射剂属于第1部毒药，相关公司及负责人涉嫌非法售卖及管有未经注册药剂制品。他表示，行动仍在进行中，可能会逮捕更多人。 _____________________________ 最后更新：2026-09-02 香港时间 22:44 编辑：谭咏麟

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, authorities are investigating unregistered injections and a specific vaccine, arresting two individuals in the process. This action underscores the importance of integrity and accountability in public health, ensuring that treatments are safe and properly regulated. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God....
reflection.zh: 在香港，当局正在调查未注册的针剂和一种特定疫苗，并在此过程中逮捕了两人。这一行动凸显了公共卫生领域诚信和问责制的重要性，确保治疗方法安全且得到妥善监管。 弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑与神同行。这一原则指导掌权者维护保护市民的标准，同时也提醒我们，真正的公义在所有事业中都包含慈爱和道德行为，包括医疗保健领域。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'AFCD won't label fighting dogs based on a glance'
title.zh: 渔护署：不会仅凭一眼就判定斗牛犬

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) has refuted claims that its officers would classify a dog as a fighting breed based solely on a cursory glance. The department clarified that such identifications are made by veterinarians who conduct thorough examinations of a dog's physical...
summary.zh: 渔业、农业及养护署（渔护署）周三否认其官员会仅凭快速观察就将犬只列为斗牛犬。该部门在一份声明中表示，斗牛犬的识别由兽医处理，他们会仔细检查犬只的身体特征——头部、耳朵和眼睛的形状，体型、身高和体长，以及身体结构。“这是国际公认的识别斗牛犬品种的做法，既科学又专业，充分考虑了犬只的实际安全风险，”声明说。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) on Wednesday dismissed a claim that its officers would label a canine as a fighting dog based merely on a quick observation. In a statement, the department said the identification of fighting dogs is handled by veterinarians, who will carefully examine the dogs’ physical features – the shape of their head, ears and eyes, their stature, height and body length, as well as body structures. “This is the internationally accepted practice for identifying fighting dog breeds, and it is both scientifically and professionally sound, taking full account of the actual safety risks posed by the dog,” it said. The department also said genetic testing is not the best method for identifying fighting dogs. Most dogs carry mixed-breed genes, and those with genes from the fighting dog breeds may not necessarily develop relevant characteristics, it explained. But the department said authorities would monitor developments in the technology and consider the possibility of using it as a supplementary tool in the future. The AFCD said the purpose of identifying fighting dogs is to safeguard the safety of the public and animals, and officers would actively communicate with dog owners in enforcement operations. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 渔农自然护理署（渔护署）周三驳回了有关官员仅根据快速观察就将犬科动物标记为斗犬的说法。该部门在一份声明中表示，斗犬的识别工作由兽医负责，他们会仔细检查斗犬的身体特征，包括头部、耳朵和眼睛的形状、身材、身高和体长以及身体结构。声明称：“这是国际上通行的斗犬品种认定做法，既科学又专业，充分考虑了斗犬带来的实际安全风险。”该部门还表示，基因测试并不是识别斗犬的最佳方法。报告解释说，大多数狗都携带混种基因，而那些带有斗犬品种基因的狗不一定会发展出相关特征。但该部门表示，当局将监控该技术的发展，并考虑未来将其用作补充工具的可能性。渔护署表示，识别斗狗的目的是保障公众及动物的安全，执法人员会积极与狗主人沟通。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: In a world quick to judge, the AFCD's approach to identifying dogs emphasizes careful, professional assessment over snap decisions. This echoes Micah 6:8, which calls us to act justly and to love mercy. True discernment requires looking beyond the surface, understanding the complexities, and applying standards with both fairness and compassion.
reflection.zh: 在这个急于评判的世界里，渔护署识别犬只的方法强调仔细、专业的评估，而非草率的决定。这呼应了弥迦书6:8，它呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯。真正的辨别力需要超越表面，理解复杂性，并以公正和怜悯之心运用标准。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Education Bureau steps in after students wait in rain for uniform and hair checks
title.zh: 教育局介入，因学生冒雨排队接受制服和发型检查

summary.en: Hong Kong education authorities have reminded a school to consider students' needs when enforcing rules after many had to wait in a long line in the rain on the first day of the academic year for uniform and hair checks. The Education Bureau also urged another school to ensure students deemed to have failed hair...
summary.zh: 香港教育部门提醒一所学校在执行规定时要考虑学生的需要，此前在新学年第一天，许多学生冒雨排长队接受制服和发型检查。教育局还敦促另一所学校确保不应不当扣留被认为发型不合格的学生。

body.en: Hong Kong education authorities have reminded a school to consider the needs of students when enforcing rules after many were forced to wait in a long line outside the campus in the rain to have their uniforms and hair checked on the first day of the new academic year. The Education Bureau also made a similar call to another school, where students deemed to have failed with hair grooming rules were told to remain on campus until they could contact their parents. Dozens of online posts showed a...
body.zh: 香港教育当局提醒学校在执行规定时考虑学生的需求，此前许多人被迫在新学年的第一天冒雨在校园外排起长队等待检查制服和头发。教育局还向另一所学校发出了类似的电话，被认为不符合发型修饰规定的学生被告知留在校园，直到他们能联系上家长。数十个在线帖子显示...

reflection.en: The image of students waiting in the rain for checks evokes a sense of vulnerability and discomfort. This situation calls to mind the ancient wisdom of speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring that rules are applied with compassion and consideration for the well-being of the young. True order is built not on rigid enforcement alone, but...
reflection.zh: 学生们冒雨排队接受检查的场景，让人联想到脆弱和不适。这种情况让人想起古老的智慧——为那些不能为自己说话的人说话，确保规则的执行既有同情心，又能顾及年轻人的福祉。真正的秩序不仅建立在严格的执行之上，更建立在对所有人的关怀和公正之上。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: China’s Xi Jinping holds talks with Sisi in first Egypt visit in a decade
title.zh: 中国国家主席习近平与塞西举行会谈，这是十年来埃及首次迎来习主席到访

summary.en: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping in Cairo, marking Xi's first visit in a decade. The leaders engaged in talks, underscored by a 21-gun salute at Ittihadiya Palace, focusing on the Middle East conflict's impact, maritime trade security, and increasing Chinese investment in...
summary.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西周三在开罗接待了到访的中国国家主席习近平，这是习近平十年来首次访问埃及。两国元首在伊蒂哈迪亚宫举行了会谈，仪式以21响礼炮开始。会谈议题包括中东冲突及其影响、海上贸易安全，以及增加中国在埃及的投资。两国均为金砖国家成员。

body.en: Egypt’s President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday received his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping on his first visit to Cairo in a decade, as Beijing seeks a greater foothold in the region against the backdrop of the US-Iran war. China’s Xi Jinping arrived in Egypt to meet President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Photo: Egypt Gov’t. The 21-gun salute at Cairo’s Ittihadiya Palace marked the start of a day of talks expected to cover the Middle East war and its fallout, including on maritime trade security, as well as boosting Chinese investment in the Arab world’s most populous country. The two BRICS members are expected to sign a slate of economic agreements, including on artificial intelligence, transport and manufacturing. Egypt currently estimates Chinese investments at around US$10 billion. Beijing has key stakes in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, which are only expected to grow as the US-Iran war threatens global maritime trade. Beijing has also played a key role in Sisi’s megaprojects, the crowning jewel of which is the New Administrative Capital 50 kilometres (30 miles) east of Cairo, large swathes of which have been bankrolled by Chinese investment. China is a major exporter to Egypt, with its trade surplus reaching US$12 billion in the first seven months of 2026, according to Chinese customs data. Across Cairo, a megalopolis home to over 26 million people, major streets have been lined with Chinese and Egyptian flags, as well as billboards showing Sisi and Xi. Street signs boast of “generations of Egyptian-Chinese friendship flowing like the Nile River”, while residents have been warned to plan for substantial traffic delays on their commutes. Xi is expected to traverse the entire capital during his visit Wednesday, including a stop at the Grand Egyptian Museum overlooking the Giza Pyramids. ‘Independent foreign policy’ According to analysts, Cairo will use the summit to underscore its strategic autonomy, showing it can leverage its close ties with both Washington and Beijing. President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi of Egypt in 2020. File photo: Graham Carlow, via UK Gov’t. Sisi, in an op-ed published in Egyptian media on Tuesday, highlighted Cairo’s “independent foreign policy”, days after a branch of Egypt’s second-largest bank was targeted by US sanctions. He wrote that Egypt and China were partners in “strengthening the role of the global south” in an increasingly polarised world. Washington vowed last month to isolate Iran economically, threatening expanded sanctions that could also hit Chinese banks, among others. China, a major buyer of Iranian oil, has vowed to safeguard its interests. Chinese leader Xi Jinping. Photo:...
body.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西周三会见了中国国家主席习近平，这是他十年来首次访问开罗，北京在美伊战争的背景下寻求在该地区取得更大的立足点。中国国家主席习近平于 2026 年 9 月 2 日星期三抵达埃及会见总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西。照片：埃及政府。开罗伊蒂哈迪亚宫鸣放21响礼炮，标志着一天会谈的开始，预计将讨论中东战争及其后果，包括海上贸易安全，以及促进中国对阿拉伯世界人口最多国家的投资。预计这两个金砖国家成员将签署一系列经济协议，包括人工智能、运输和制造领域的协议。埃及目前估计中国投资约为100亿美元。北京在苏伊士运河经济区拥有重要利益，随着美伊战争威胁全球海上贸易，这一利益预计只会增长。北京也在塞西的大型项目中发挥了关键作用，其中最重要的一颗明珠是位于开罗以东 50 公里（30 英里）的新行政首都，其中大片地区由中国投资提供资金。中国是埃及的主要出口国，根据中国海关数据，2026年前7个月中国的贸易顺差达到120亿美元。开罗这座拥有超过 2600 万人口的大都市，在整个主要街道上都挂满了中国和埃及国旗，以及印有塞西和习近平的广告牌。街道标牌上写着“埃中世代友谊像尼罗河一样流淌”，居民们也被警告要做好通勤路上严重交通延误的准备。预计习近平在周三访问期间将穿越整个首都，包括在俯瞰吉萨金字塔的大埃及博物馆停留。 “独立的外交政策” 分析人士称，开罗将利用这次峰会强调其战略自主权，表明它可以利用与华盛顿和北京的密切关系。 2020 年埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西。资料图片：格雷厄姆·卡洛，来自英国政府。就在埃及第二大银行的一家分行遭到美国制裁的几天后，塞西在埃及媒体周二发表的一篇专栏文章中强调了开罗的“独立外交政策”。他写道，埃及和中国是在日益两极分化的世界中“加强南半球的作用”的合作伙伴。华盛顿上个月誓言要在经济上孤立伊朗，并威胁扩大制裁，这也可能打击中国的银行等。中国是伊朗石油的主要买家，誓言维护自身利益。中国领导人习近平。照片：...

reflection.en: As leaders from Egypt and China convene for high-level talks, the world watches for signs of diplomatic engagement. The pursuit of peace and stability, even amidst complex geopolitical currents, is a vital endeavor. May these discussions foster understanding and lay groundwork for a more secure and prosperous future for the region and beyond.
reflection.zh: 埃及和中国领导人举行高级别会谈，世界正关注外交互动的迹象。即使在复杂的地缘政治背景下，追求和平与稳定也是一项至关重要的事业。愿此次会谈能增进理解，为该地区及更广泛范围的未来安全与繁荣奠定基础。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Lawmaker urges Hong Kong gov’t to introduce comprehensive population policy amid record-low births
title.zh: 议员敦促香港政府推出全面人口政策，应对生育率创纪录新低

summary.en: A pro-Beijing lawmaker in Hong Kong has called on the government to implement a comprehensive population policy and to investigate young people's views on childbearing, citing record-low birth rates over the past year. Nixie Lam, a legislator, suggested forming a dedicated task force to research the issue.
summary.zh: 一位亲北京的香港议员呼吁政府实施一项全面的人口政策，并研究年轻人对生育的看法，因为过去一年记录到的出生率创下新低。议员林素蔚建议成立一个专门的工作小组进行研究。

body.en: A pro-Beijing Hong Kong lawmaker has urged the government to introduce a comprehensive population policy and to study young people’s thoughts on childbearing amid record-low births logged over the past year. Nixie Lam, a legislator with the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong (DAB), told RTHK Radio 1 on Wednesday that although the government has introduced measures to boost fertility, it has so far presented “no comprehensive population policy.” DAB Legislative Council lawmaker Nixie Lam. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Lam urged authorities to set up a population policy task force, led by secretarial-grade officers, to conduct research into what young people think about starting families and raising children. “Different policies [linked to fertility] are scattered around different bureaux and government departments,” Lam said in Cantonese, “but without a comprehensive policy people will wonder if the government is actually doing anything to help.“ “In particular, with regard to whether young people want to have children and what impacts [that decision], what pressures they are facing… the government has not conducted any research in recent years,” Lam said. “Without research, we are still using ideas from the last century to formulate relevant policies.” Fewer than 30,000 babies were born in Hong Kong over the past year – a record low for the territory. The number of new births in 2025 came in at around half that of 2015, according to figures from the Census and Statistics Department. Children in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. These figures come in spite of new measures introduced to boost the local fertility rate, including a new tax allowance for residents receiving assisted reproductive services. In late 2023, a one-off cash allowance of HK$20,000 was offered as a financial incentive to eligible parents. It is unclear whether the “Newborn Baby Bonus” scheme, which was implemented for a period of three years, will be extended when it expires in October. Speaking to the public broadcaster, Lam called on the government to continue providing these payments. Children look at the skyline of Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. She said authorities should not simply cancel the bonus scheme without introducing a comprehensive population policy. Shrinking primary school classes Enrolment at Hong Kong’s kindergartens and primary schools has been dipping amid the record-low birth rate and emigration from the city. Ming Pao reported on Wednesday that, in the new school year, 127 of 446 government-subsidised primary schools in Hong Kong had cut back on Primary One classes. Of these, 60 offered only one Primary One class in the new academic year and...
body.zh: 一位亲北京的香港立法会议员敦促政府推出全面的人口政策，并在过去一年的出生率创历史新低的情况下研究年轻人对生育的想法。民主建港联盟（民建联）立法会议员林郑月娥周三对香港电台第一台表示，尽管政府出台了提高生育率的措施，但迄今为止“尚未提出全面的人口政策”。民建联立法会议员林郑月娥。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。林郑月娥敦促当局成立一个由秘书级人员领导的人口政策专责小组，研究年轻人对组建家庭和抚养孩子的看法。 “（与生育相关的）不同政策分散在不同的政策局和政府部门，”林郑月娥用粤语说道，“但如果没有一项全面的政策，人们会怀疑政府是否真的在采取任何措施来提供帮助。” “特别是，关于年轻人是否想要孩子以及什么影响（这个决定）、他们面临什么压力……政府近年来没有进行任何研究，”林说。 “没有研究，我们还在用上个世纪的想法来制定相关政策。”过去一年，香港的出生人数不足 30,000 人，创下香港历史新低。根据政府统计处的数据，2025 年的新生儿数量约为 2015 年的一半。香港的孩子们。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。尽管采取了新措施来提高当地生育率，包括为接受辅助生殖服务的居民提供新的税收补贴，但这些数字还是出现了。 2023年底，政府向合资格家长提供一次性20,000港元现金津贴，作为经济奖励。目前尚不清楚为期三年的“新生婴儿奖金”计划在10月份到期后是否会延长。林郑月娥在接受公共广播公司采访时呼吁政府继续提供这些款项。孩子们眺望香港的天际线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。她表示，当局不应在没有出台全面人口政策的情况下简单地取消奖金计划。小学班级规模缩小 由于出生率创历史新低以及人口外流，香港幼儿园和小学的入学率一直在下降。 《明报》周三报道称，新学年，香港446所政府资助小学中，有127所削减了小一课程。其中，60所学校在新学年只开设一门小一课程，并且......

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong highlights a growing concern over declining birth rates, prompting calls for government intervention. This situation invites reflection on the profound gift of children, as Psalm 127:3 reminds us, "Children are a heritage from Yahweh, the fruit of the womb a reward." May leaders and citizens alike consider the value and blessing of...
reflection.zh: 香港传来的消息凸显了人们对出生率下降日益增长的担忧，并呼吁政府介入。这种情况引人反思子女的宝贵恩赐，正如诗篇127:3所提醒我们的：“儿女是雅伟所赐的产业；所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。”愿领导者和民众都能珍视新生命的价值与祝福。
